47 // DQ (11/17/2007): This function must be defined in this file since it
48 // references a c_action function (defined in this file). This file
49 // is not linked into librose.
50 void build_implicit_program_statement_if_required()
51 {
52  initialize_global_scope_if_required();
53 
54  // If we will not be seeing a program-stmt, function-stmt, or subroutine-stmt then
55  // we need to generate a program-stmt as a compiler generated construct.
56  SgScopeStatement* currentScope = getTopOfScopeStack();
57  if (currentScope->variantT() == V_SgGlobal)
58  {
59  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_COMMENT_LEVEL
60  )
61  printf("Building an implicit program-stmt: currentScope = %p = %s \n", currentScope,
62  currentScope->class_name().c_str());
63 
64  // DQ (1/14/2011): Take care of types declared in the global scope.
65  // DQ (1/13/2011): Where this is in a module or type declaration other types may be referenced
66  // which are constructed as SgTypeDefault and thus must be fixed up as soon as possible (i.e.
67  // before references to them are possible in executable statements). This function fixes up these
68  // references.
69  fixup_forward_type_declarations();
70 
71  // Token_t id = { 1, 1, 0, "rose_implicit_program_header" };
72  Token_t id =
73  { 1, 1, 0, (char*) ROSE_IMPLICIT_FORTRAN_PROGRAM_NAME };
74  c_action_program_stmt(NULL, NULL, &id, NULL);
75 
76  // Reset the currentScope (should be a SgBasicBlock)
77  currentScope = getTopOfScopeStack();
78 #if 0
79  printf ("In build_implicit_program_statement_if_required(): currentScope is %s in file = %s \n",currentScope->class_name().c_str(),currentScope->get_startOfConstruct()->get_filename());
80 #endif
81  }
82 }

651  void c_action_intrinsic_type_spec(Token_t * keyword1, Token_t * keyword2,
652  int type, ofp_bool hasKindSelector)
653  {
654  // Save the type on the stack for use later.
655 
656  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
657  printf(
658  "In c_action_intrinsic_type_spec(): keyword1 = %p = %s keyword2 = %p = %s type = %d, hasKindSelector = %s \n",
659  keyword1, keyword1 != NULL ? keyword1->text : "NULL", keyword2,
660  keyword2 != NULL ? keyword2->text : "NULL", type,
661  hasKindSelector ? "true" : "false");
662 
663 #if 0
664  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
665  outputState("At TOP of R403 c_action_intrinsic_type_spec()");
666 #endif
667 
668 #if !SKIP_C_ACTION_IMPLEMENTATION
669  // Build a SgType from the type code
670  SgType* intrinsicType = createType(type);
671  ROSE_ASSERT(intrinsicType != NULL);
672  astBaseTypeStack.push_front(intrinsicType);
673 
674  if (hasKindSelector == true)
675  {
676 #if 0
677  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
678  outputState("hasKindSelector == true in R403 c_action_intrinsic_type_spec()");
679 #endif
680  int rank = astExpressionStack.size();
681  // We want this to be either a SgAsteriskShapeExp or an SgIntVal
682  SgExpression* lengthExpression = NULL;
683  SgExpression* kindExpression = NULL;
684 
685  // DQ (8/21/2010): The length expression (kind, length, or tyep-spec) for the
686  // type is what we are trying to identify. Depending on the version of Fortran
687  // and the syntax used to specify the kind.
688 
689  // Note that for CHARACTER types the length of the string is on the astExpressionStack, but for
690  // where it is a kind parameter it is on the astTypeKindStack.
691  if (astExpressionStack.empty() == false)
692  {
693 #if 0
694  printf ("Taking the length parameter from the stack <type>*<n> syntax used \n");
695 #endif
696  lengthExpression = astExpressionStack.front();
697  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
698  }
699  else
700  {
701  if (astTypeKindStack.empty() == false)
702  {
703  // Note that it is (I think) possible for a string to be declared "character*n" where
704  // "n" is an integer expression. I need a test code for this before I can fix it.
705  // lengthExpression = isSgIntVal(astTypeKindStack.front());
706  kindExpression = astTypeKindStack.front();
707  ROSE_ASSERT(kindExpression != NULL);
708  astTypeKindStack.pop_front();
709  }
710 
711  if (isSgTypeChar(intrinsicType) != NULL)
712  {
713  // For character strings the kind should always be 1.
714  // ROSE_ASSERT(lengthExpression->get_value() == 1);
715  // Find the length of the string in the astTypeParameterStack
716  if (astTypeParameterStack.empty() == false)
717  {
718  rank = astTypeParameterStack.size();
719  ROSE_ASSERT(rank == 1);
720 
721  lengthExpression
722  = isSgIntVal(astTypeParameterStack.front());
723  if (lengthExpression == NULL)
724  {
725 #if 0
726  printf ("Warning type parameter is non integer type (OK for F90) \n");
727 #endif
728  lengthExpression = astTypeParameterStack.front();
729  }
730  ROSE_ASSERT(lengthExpression != NULL);
731  astTypeParameterStack.pop_front();
732  }
733  }
734  }
735 #if 0
736  printf ("In c_action_intrinsic_type_spec(): intrinsicType = %p = %s \n",intrinsicType,intrinsicType->class_name().c_str());
737 #endif
738  // Base on the base type, we want to inteprete the type parameters, kind parameters, etc.
739  // and generate the correct mapping to the type IR node in the ROSE and use that in the AST.
740  switch (intrinsicType->variantT())
741  {
742  case V_SgTypeChar:
743  {
744  SgType* baseType;
745  if (lengthExpression)
746  {
747  baseType = SgTypeString::createType(lengthExpression,
748  kindExpression);
749  }
750  else
751  {
752  baseType = SgTypeChar::createType(kindExpression);
753  }
754  astBaseTypeStack.pop_front();
755  astBaseTypeStack.push_front(baseType);
756  break;
757  }
758 
759  case V_SgTypeInt:
760  {
761  // Note that this does not have to be an integer value and can be another variable or "c_int" (for example)
762  // DQ (10/4/2010): Moved to new (improved) design of type_kind data member in SgType.
763  ROSE_ASSERT(kindExpression);
764  ROSE_ASSERT(kindExpression->get_parent() == NULL);
765  SgTypeInt* integerType = SgTypeInt::createType(0, kindExpression);
766  kindExpression->set_parent(integerType);
767  ROSE_ASSERT(kindExpression->get_parent() != NULL);
768 
769  // Replace the base type with the just built string type
770  astBaseTypeStack.pop_front();
771  astBaseTypeStack.push_front(integerType);
772  break;
773  }
774 
775  case V_SgTypeBool:
776  {
777  // DQ (10/4/2010): Logical types are now represented with the associated kind.
778  SgTypeBool* boolType = SgTypeBool::createType(kindExpression);
779  ROSE_ASSERT(kindExpression->get_parent() == NULL);
780  kindExpression->set_parent(boolType);
781 
782  // Replace the base type with the just built string type
783  astBaseTypeStack.pop_front();
784  astBaseTypeStack.push_front(boolType);
785  break;
786  }
787 
788  case V_SgTypeFloat:
789  {
790  ROSE_ASSERT(kindExpression->get_parent() == NULL);
791  SgTypeFloat* floatType = SgTypeFloat::createType(kindExpression);
792  kindExpression->set_parent(floatType);
793  ROSE_ASSERT(kindExpression->get_parent() != NULL);
794 
795  // Replace the base type with the just built string type
796  astBaseTypeStack.pop_front();
797  astBaseTypeStack.push_front(floatType);

1004  setSourcePosition(pValueExp, boz_const);
1005 
1006  astExpressionStack.push_front(pValueExp);

3037  setStatementNumericLabel(DeclAttributes.getDeclaration(),label);

3039  if (!varDecl)
3040  {
3041  cerr << "ERROR: line " << eos->line << ", col " << eos->col << " - Expect a SgVariableDeclaration, but get a " << DeclAttributes.getDeclaration()->class_name() << endl;
3042  ROSE_ABORT();

3045  SgInitializedName* firstInitializedNameForSourcePosition = varList.front();
3046  SgInitializedName* lastInitializedNameForSourcePosition = varList.back();
3047  ROSE_ASSERT(DeclAttributes.getDeclaration()->get_startOfConstruct() != NULL);
3048  ROSE_ASSERT(firstInitializedNameForSourcePosition->get_startOfConstruct() != NULL);
3049  ROSE_ASSERT(lastInitializedNameForSourcePosition->get_startOfConstruct() != NULL);
3050  *(DeclAttributes.getDeclaration()->get_startOfConstruct()) = *(firstInitializedNameForSourcePosition->get_startOfConstruct());
3051  *(DeclAttributes.getDeclaration()->get_endOfConstruct()) = *(lastInitializedNameForSourcePosition->get_startOfConstruct());
3052  DeclAttributes.reset();

3092  printf("type == DeclarationTypeSpec_INTRINSIC \n");

3521  void c_action_entity_decl(Token_t * id, ofp_bool hasArraySpec,
3522  ofp_bool hasCoarraySpec, ofp_bool hasCharLength,
3523  ofp_bool hasInitialization)
3524  {
3525  // This function R504 R503-F2008 is similar to R442 R438-F2008
3526 
3527  // Push the entities onto the list at the top of the stack
3528  ROSE_ASSERT(id != NULL);
3529  ROSE_ASSERT(id->text != NULL);
3530 
3531  // DQ (1/28/2009): We need to have the global scope and the function scope in place before
3532  // building variable declarations. See test2007_09.f90.
3533  // initialize_global_scope_if_required(); not required!
3534  build_implicit_program_statement_if_required();
3535 
3536  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
3537  {
3538  // printf ("In R504 R503-F2008 c_action_entity_decl(): save variableName = %s \n",id->text);
3539  string current_filename = getCurrentFilename();
3540  printf(
3541  "In R504 R503-F2008 c_action_entity_decl(): save variableName = %s file = %s hasArraySpec = %s hasCoarraySpec = %s hasCharLength = %s hasInitialization = %s \n",
3542  id->text, current_filename.c_str(),
3543  hasArraySpec ? "true" : "false",
3544  hasCoarraySpec ? "true" : "false",
3545  hasCharLength ? "true" : "false",
3546  hasInitialization ? "true" : "false");
3547  }
3548 
3549 #if 0
3550  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
3551  outputState("At TOP of R504 R503-F2008 c_action_entity_decl()");
3552 #endif
3553 
3554 #if !SKIP_C_ACTION_IMPLEMENTATION
3555  // Merge the entity attributes with the declaration attributes in order to build the correct type for the entity-decl
3556  AttributeRec entityAttr;
3557  entityAttr = DeclAttributes;
3558  SgExpression* initialization = NULL;
3559  if (hasInitialization)
3560  {
3561  ROSE_ASSERT(!astExpressionStack.empty()); // astExpressionStack.front() contains initialization expression
3562  initialization = astExpressionStack.front();
3563  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
3564  }
3565  if (hasCharLength)
3566  {
3567  ROSE_ASSERT(!astExpressionStack.empty()); // astExpressionStack() contains char_length expression
3568  entityAttr.setLenExpr(astExpressionStack.front());
3569  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
3570  }
3571  if (hasCoarraySpec)
3572  {
3573  SgExprListExp* coarraySpec = entityAttr.buildDimensionInfo();
3574  ROSE_ASSERT(coarraySpec);
3575  entityAttr.setCodimExp(coarraySpec);
3576  entityAttr.setHasCodimension(true);
3577  }
3578  if (hasArraySpec)
3579  {
3580  SgExprListExp* arraySpec = entityAttr.buildDimensionInfo();
3581  ROSE_ASSERT(arraySpec);
3582  entityAttr.setDimExp(arraySpec);
3583  entityAttr.setHasDimension(true);
3584  }
3585  // Now, we are ready to build the type the entity-decl:
3586  SgType* entityType = entityAttr.computeEntityType();
3587 
3588 #if 0
3589  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
3590  outputState(" c_action_entity_decl(): after computing entity's type:");
3591 #endif
3592 
3593  // Compute the appropriate initializer if any:
3594  SgInitializer* initializer = NULL;
3595  if (hasInitialization)
3596  {
3597  if (isSgClassType(entityType))
3598  {
3599  // if entityType is a derived type then the initialzer must be a SgConstructorInitializer.
3600  SgConstructorInitializer* constructorInitializer = isSgConstructorInitializer(initialization);
3601  // Rasmussen (1/4/2019): I believe this is too strong
3602  // For example: type(c_ptr) = c_null_ptr, in which case c_null_ptr is an SgVarRefExp (I believe)
3603  // I removed assertion and changed logic to allow initializer not to be a constructor initializer
3604  // ROSE_ASSERT(constructorInitializer);
3605  if (constructorInitializer)
3606  {
3607  initializer = constructorInitializer;
3608  }
3609  }
3610 
3611  // Rasmussen (1/4/2019): allow for SgClassType as well
3612  if (initializer == NULL)
3613  {

3623  SgVariableSymbol* variableSymbol = NULL;
3624  SgFunctionSymbol* functionSymbol = NULL;
3625  SgClassSymbol* classSymbol = NULL;

3628  trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_variable_symbol_but_do_not_build_variable(name, currentScope, variableSymbol, functionSymbol, classSymbol);

3632  // in which case, fix up the return type of the function in question; however if this entity decl is a compoent decl
3633  // then it has nothing to do with the functions in enclosing scopes and so do not fix up the return type of any function.
3634  // If the entity_decl is inside of a function, check to see if it matches the function's name;

3638  if (needFuncTypeUpdate)
3639  {
3640  ROSE_ASSERT(initializer == NULL);
3641  SgFunctionType* functionType = isSgFunctionType(functionSymbol->get_type());
3642  ROSE_ASSERT(functionType != NULL);
3643  functionType->set_return_type(entityType);
3644  functionType->set_orig_return_type(entityType);
3645  }
3646  SgInitializedName* initializedName = NULL;
3647  if (variableSymbol != NULL)
3648  {
3649  ROSE_ASSERT(entityType != NULL);
3650 
3651  // Pei-Hung (07/19/2019) a variable inside a derived type can have the same name as other varible
3652  // in other scope. If the case happens, we should build the initialized name for the variable
3653  // inside the derived type

3655  ROSE_ASSERT(initializedName != NULL);
3656 
3657  SgType* variableType = initializedName->get_type();
3658 
3659  if(isSgDerivedTypeStatement(currentScope->get_parent()) != NULL && currentScope != initializedName->get_scope())
3660  {
3661  initializedName = buildInitializedNameAndPutOntoStack(name, entityType, initializer);
3662  }
3663  else
3664  {
3665  initializedName = variableSymbol->get_declaration();
3666  ROSE_ASSERT(initializedName != NULL);
3667  ROSE_ASSERT(initializedName->get_scope() != NULL);
3668  SgFunctionDefinition* functionDefinition = isSgFunctionDefinition(initializedName->get_scope());
3669  if (functionDefinition != NULL)
3670  {
3671  SgProcedureHeaderStatement* functionDeclaration = isSgProcedureHeaderStatement(functionDefinition->get_parent());
3672  ROSE_ASSERT(functionDeclaration != NULL);
3673  if (functionDeclaration->get_result_name() == initializedName)
3674  {
3675  SgFunctionType* functionType = isSgFunctionType(functionDeclaration->get_type());
3676  ROSE_ASSERT(functionType != NULL);
3677  functionType->set_return_type(entityType);
3678  functionType->set_orig_return_type(entityType);
3679  }
3680  // Pei-Hung (07/19/2019) In test2019_common_block_name.f90,
3681  // array dimension info can be specified in common block before the type specification
3682  if(isSgArrayType(variableType) != NULL)
3683  {
3684  SgArrayType* arrayType = isSgArrayType(variableType);
3685  ROSE_ASSERT(arrayType != NULL);

3687  entityAttr.setDimExp(dimInfo);
3688  entityAttr.setHasDimension(true);
3689  entityType = entityAttr.computeEntityType();
3690  }
3691  initializedName->set_type(entityType);
3692  }
3693  else
3694  {
3695  if (currentScope != initializedName->get_scope())
3696  initializedName = buildInitializedNameAndPutOntoStack(name, entityType, initializer);
3697  else
3698  {
3699  // Pei-Hung (07/19/2019) In test2019_common_block_name.f90,
3700  // array dimension info can be specified in common block before the type specification
3701  if(isSgArrayType(variableType) != NULL)
3702  {
3703  SgArrayType* arrayType = isSgArrayType(variableType);
3704  ROSE_ASSERT(arrayType != NULL);
3705  SgExprListExp* dimInfo = arrayType->get_dim_info();
3706  entityAttr.setDimExp(dimInfo);
3707  entityAttr.setHasDimension(true);
3708  entityType = entityAttr.computeEntityType();
3709  }
3710  initializedName->set_type(entityType);
3711  }
3712  }
3713  }
3714  ROSE_ASSERT(initializedName != NULL);
3715  }
3716  else
3717  {
3718  if (needFuncTypeUpdate)
3719  { // only applies to non component entities.
3720  ROSE_ASSERT(initializedName == NULL);
3721  initializedName = new SgInitializedName(name, entityType, initializer, NULL, NULL);
3722  SgProcedureHeaderStatement* functionDeclaration = isSgProcedureHeaderStatement(functionSymbol->get_declaration());
3723  functionDeclaration->set_result_name(initializedName);
3724  }
3725  else
3726  {
3727  initializedName = buildInitializedNameAndPutOntoStack(name, entityType, initializer);
3728  }
3729  }
3730  ROSE_ASSERT(initializedName != NULL);
3731  setSourcePosition(initializedName, id);

3734  SgVariableDeclaration* varDecl = isSgVariableDeclaration(DeclAttributes.getDeclaration());
3735  if (!varDecl)
3736  {
3737  cerr << "ERROR: line " << id->line << ", col " << id->col
3738  << " - Expect a SgVariableDeclaration, but get a "

3746  // with appropriate symbol table information: (see buildVariableDeclaration in fortran_support.C)
3747  SgFunctionDefinition* functionDefinition = isSgFunctionDefinition(astScopeStack.front()->get_parent());

3756  // Link the SgInitializedName in the variable declaration with its entry in the function parameter list.
3757  initializedName->set_prev_decl_item(variableSymbol->get_declaration());

3759  variableSymbol->get_declaration()->set_type(initializedName->get_type());

3767  variableSymbol = getTopOfScopeStack()->lookup_variable_symbol(variableName);
3768  initializedName->set_scope(astScopeStack.front());
3769  if (variableSymbol == NULL)
3770  {
3771  variableSymbol = new SgVariableSymbol(initializedName);
3772  astScopeStack.front()->insert_symbol(variableName, variableSymbol);
3773  ROSE_ASSERT (initializedName->get_symbol_from_symbol_table () != NULL);
3774  }
3775  }
3776 
3777  ROSE_ASSERT(!astNameStack.empty());
3778  astNameStack.pop_front();
3779  if (!astTypeStack.empty())
3780  astTypeStack.pop_front();
3781  ROSE_ASSERT(astTypeStack.empty());

6537  void c_action_common_block_object(Token_t *id, ofp_bool hasShapeSpecList)
6538  {
6539  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
6540  printf(
6541  "In c_action_common_block_object(): id = %p = %s hasShapeSpecList = %s \n",
6542  id, id != NULL ? id->text : "NULL",
6543  hasShapeSpecList ? "true" : "false");
6544 
6545  ROSE_ASSERT(id != NULL);
6546  SgName variableName = id->text;
6547 
6548  // Look for the symbol associated with the variable given by the name starting
6549  // at the current scope and working backwards through the parent scopes.
6550  SgVariableSymbol* variableSymbol =
6551  trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_variable_symbol(variableName, getTopOfScopeStack());
6552 
6553  SgExpression* constructedReference = NULL;
6554 
6555  if (variableSymbol != NULL)
6556  {
6557  if (hasShapeSpecList == true)
6558  {
6559  // There must be a scalar variable declaration for this symbol because we found a symbol and
6560  // there is a shape-spec-list (the array specification can't be in two places). Thus the
6561  // common-block-object acts like a dimension statement and the variable type should be
6562  // converted into an array type (see c_action_dimension_decl) [Rasmussen, 2019.06.19].
6563 
6564  // We need to get the declaration of the variable
6565  SgInitializedName* arrayVariable = variableSymbol->get_declaration();
6566  ROSE_ASSERT(arrayVariable != NULL);
6567 
6568  SgType* arrayVariableBaseType = arrayVariable->get_type();
6569  ROSE_ASSERT(arrayVariableBaseType != NULL);
6570 
6571  DeclAttributes.setBaseType(arrayVariableBaseType);
6572  SgExprListExp* dimInfo = DeclAttributes.buildDimensionInfo();
6573  ROSE_ASSERT(dimInfo);
6574  SgArrayType* arrayVariableType = DeclAttributes.buildArrayType(dimInfo);
6575  arrayVariable->set_type(arrayVariableType);
6576  DeclAttributes.reset();
6577  }
6578 
6579  SgVarRefExp* variableReference = new SgVarRefExp(variableSymbol);
6580  setSourcePosition(variableReference, id);
6581 
6582  constructedReference = variableReference;
6583  }
6584  else
6585  {
6586  // The variable has not previously been declared.
6587  // OR it maybe declared at some point in the future (see test2010_51.90).
6588 
6589  // DQ (1/19/2011): Build the implicit variable
6590  buildImplicitVariableDeclaration(variableName);
6591 
6592  // Now verify that it is present.
6593  variableSymbol = trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_variable_symbol(variableName,astScopeStack.front());
6594  ROSE_ASSERT(variableSymbol != NULL);
6595  // Pei-Hung (07/19/2019) implicit variable can also have array specification
6596  // See example in test2019_common_block_name.f90.
6597  if (hasShapeSpecList == true)
6598  {
6599  // There must be a scalar variable declaration for this symbol because we found a symbol and
6600  // there is a shape-spec-list (the array specification can't be in two places). Thus the
6601  // common-block-object acts like a dimension statement and the variable type should be
6602  // converted into an array type (see c_action_dimension_decl) [Rasmussen, 2019.06.19].
6603 
6604  // We need to get the declaration of the variable
6605  SgInitializedName* arrayVariable = variableSymbol->get_declaration();
6606  ROSE_ASSERT(arrayVariable != NULL);
6607 
6608  SgType* arrayVariableBaseType = arrayVariable->get_type();
6609  ROSE_ASSERT(arrayVariableBaseType != NULL);
6610 
6611  DeclAttributes.setBaseType(arrayVariableBaseType);
6612  SgExprListExp* dimInfo = DeclAttributes.buildDimensionInfo();
6613  ROSE_ASSERT(dimInfo);
6614  SgArrayType* arrayVariableType = DeclAttributes.buildArrayType(dimInfo);
6615  arrayVariable->set_type(arrayVariableType);
6616  DeclAttributes.reset();
6617  }
6618 
6619  constructedReference = new SgVarRefExp(variableSymbol);
6620  setSourcePosition(constructedReference, id);
6621  }
6622 
6623  ROSE_ASSERT(constructedReference != NULL);
6624  astExpressionStack.push_front(constructedReference);
6625

6910  void c_action_data_ref(int numPartRef)
6911  {
6912  // DQ (12/29/2010): See notes on how R612 and R613 operate together.
6913 
6914  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
6915  printf(
6916  "In R612 c_action_data_ref(): (variable built here) numPartRef = %d \n",
6917  numPartRef);
6918 
6919 #if 0
6920  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
6921  outputState("At TOP of R612 c_action_data_ref()");
6922 #endif
6923 
6924  // This should at least be non-negative.
6925  ROSE_ASSERT(numPartRef >= 0);
6926 
6927  // DQ (12/29/2010): Form the full name as a vector of strcutures specific to suporting R612 and R613.
6928  std::vector<MultipartReferenceType> qualifiedNameList(numPartRef);
6929 
6930  // Iterate backwards from the front of the list for the first numPartRef entries.
6931  std::list<MultipartReferenceType>::iterator j =
6932  astMultipartReferenceStack.begin();
6933  ROSE_ASSERT (j != astMultipartReferenceStack.end());
6934  for (int i = 0; i < numPartRef; i++)
6935  {
6936  // Assemble the entries into the qualifiedNameList from back to front.
6937  qualifiedNameList[(numPartRef - 1) - i] = *j;
6938 
6939  ROSE_ASSERT (j != astMultipartReferenceStack.end());
6940  j++;
6941  }
6942 
6943 #if 0
6944  string qualifiedNameString = generateQualifiedName(qualifiedNameList);
6945  printf ("@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@ R612 qualifiedNameString = %s \n",qualifiedNameString.c_str());
6946 #endif
6947 
6948 #if !SKIP_C_ACTION_IMPLEMENTATION
6949  // Build the SgVarRefExp object
6950 
6951  // Get the token (and the name in side of the token) previously saved on the stack
6952  AstNameType* nameToken = getTopOfNameStack();
6953  ROSE_ASSERT(nameToken != NULL);
6954 
6955  SgName variableName = qualifiedNameList[numPartRef - 1].name;
6956  ROSE_ASSERT(variableName == nameToken->text);
6957 
6958  // printf ("In R612 (part of multi-part ref) variableName = %s \n",variableName.str());
6959 
6960  // Look for the symbol associated with the variable given by the name starting
6961  // at the current scope and working backwards through the parent scopes.
6962  std::vector<SgSymbol*> variableSymbolList =
6963  trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_member_variable_symbol(qualifiedNameList, getTopOfScopeStack());
6964  SgVariableSymbol* variableSymbol = variableSymbolList.empty()? NULL : isSgVariableSymbol(variableSymbolList[0]);
6965 
6966  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_COMMENT_LEVEL)
6967  {
6968  printf(
6969  "After trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_member_variable_symbol(%s,astScopeStack) variableSymbol = %p = %s \n",
6970  variableName.str(),
6971  variableSymbol,
6972  variableSymbol ? SageInterface::get_name(variableSymbol).c_str()
6973  : "NULL");
6974  cout << "variableSymbolList.size() = " << variableSymbolList.size()
6975  << endl;
6976  }
6977 
6978  // We should have found no more symbols than numPartRef (.e.g if this is an implicit variable then variableSymbolList would be empty.
6979  ROSE_ASSERT(variableSymbolList.size() <= (size_t)numPartRef);
6980 
6981  // DQ (12/29/2010): Moved outside of conditional so that it could be tested afteward.
6982  SgFunctionSymbol* functionSymbol = NULL;
6983 
6984 #if 0
6985  printf ("In R612: variableSymbol = %p \n",variableSymbol);
6986 #endif
6987  if (variableSymbol == NULL)
6988  {
6989  // And there was no list of variables returned...(see test2010_176.f90 for an
6990  // example that fails this test; return value initialization for derived type).
6991  // ROSE_ASSERT(variableSymbolList.empty() == true);
6992 
6993  // This is a function call and the 'coExpr' detected above, if any, will be ignored in this routine.
6994  // Preserve it for future use in 'c_action_rice_spawn_stmt'.
6995  // TODO: check that coExpr is present here only if in the context of a Rice CAF2 'spawn' statement.
6996  if (qualifiedNameList[0].hasImageSelector)
6997  {
6998  rice_dataref_coexpr = isSgCAFCoExpression(astExpressionStack.front());
6999  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
7000  qualifiedNameList[0].hasImageSelector = false; // avoid processing the image selector twice
7001  }
7002 
7003  // DQ (12/21/2010): For the variable to not have existed, this must be the simple case of a reference with a single part.
7004  // (see test2010_176.f90 for an example that fails this test; return value initialization for derived type).
7005  ROSE_ASSERT(numPartRef <= 1 || ( (variableSymbolList.empty() == false) && (isSgFunctionSymbol(variableSymbolList[0]) != NULL) ) );
7006 
7007  // This is a variable that has not been previously declared (Fortran allows this inplicit declaration),
7008  // but first check to make sure it is not an implicit function.
7009  bool isAnIntrinsicFunction = matchAgainstIntrinsicFunctionList(nameToken->text);
7010 
7011  if ((variableSymbolList.empty() == false) && (isSgFunctionSymbol(variableSymbolList[0]) != NULL))
7012  {
7013  // This is the case of an initialization of a function return type for a derived type (see test2010_176.f90 for an example).
7014  // functionSymbol = isSgFunctionSymbol(variableSymbolList[0]);
7015  // ROSE_ASSERT(functionSymbol != NULL);
7016 
7017  // DXN: discard intrinsic function name
7018  if (isAnIntrinsicFunction)
7019  variableSymbolList.erase(variableSymbolList.begin());
7020  else
7021  functionSymbol = isSgFunctionSymbol(variableSymbolList[0]);
7022  }
7023  else
7024  {
7025  // DQ (12/29/2010): I think I can assert this...works for all our basic test codes in Fortran_tests/*.f,f90,f03...
7026  ROSE_ASSERT(numPartRef == 1);
7027 
7028  // Note that this function call would not make sense if numPartRef > 1 since the input scope would be wrong.
7029  functionSymbol = trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_function_symbol(variableName, getTopOfScopeStack());
7030  }
7031  // DQ (4/29/2008): Added support for detecting derived types
7032  SgClassSymbol* classSymbol = NULL;
7033  if (numPartRef == 1)
7034  {
7035  // This function call only makes since if numPartRef == 1 since only then is the scope reasonable.
7036  classSymbol = trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_derived_type_symbol(variableName, getTopOfScopeStack());
7037  }
7038 
7039  bool isANonIntrinsicFunction = (functionSymbol != NULL); // DXN: && !isAnIntrinsicFunction
7040 
7041  // DQ (4/29/2008): Added support for detecting derived types
7042  bool isADerivedType = classSymbol != NULL;
7043 
7044  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_COMMENT_LEVEL)
7045  {

7905  void c_action_part_ref(Token_t * id, ofp_bool hasSelectionSubscriptList, ofp_bool hasImageSelector)
7906  {
7907  // This is a part of a variable reference (any likely used many other places as well)
7908 
7909  // DQ (12/29/2010): Notes on how R612 and R613 operate together.
7910  // This rule works with R612 to support references to names that have multiple parts (e.g. struct%field, etc.)
7911  // However, it is difficult to support but R612 and R613, so a lot of work has gone into these functions.
7912  // This function (R613) does not modify state (except for the handling of a statement function where any
7913  // previous symbol of that name is removed in preparation for R612 to build a proper statement function IR node
7914  // (as I recall). Mostly this function pushes the name onto the astNameStack, but it is a problem that the
7915  // value of hasSelectionSubscriptList is lost and not saved since it is needed to correctly handle the
7916  // interpretation of the names and know which are associated with index expression (SgExprList IR nodes
7917  // already saved onto the stack. So we add another auxilery stack to save the information about the value
7918  // of the hasSelectionSubscriptList.
7919 
7920  // A possible alternative to saving the value of the hasSelectionSubscriptList might be to do more processing
7921  // in this R613 rule. However, the order of calls to R613 does not permit a stack to be used to save the
7922  // scope to which a named reference can be interpreted. All names must be evaluated once the full list of
7923  // multiple parts are available (i.e. in R612). I don't think there is any option here. so most processing is
7924  // done in R612 and very little can be done in R612.
7925 
7926  // DQ (12/14/2007): Make sure that we have added the implicit program function to the scope (see test2007_17.f90)
7927 
7928  // Pei-Hung (11/15/2019) implicit program should be built at statement, not expression
7929  // build_implicit_program_statement_if_required();
7930 
7931  ROSE_ASSERT(id != NULL);
7932 
7933  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
7934  printf(
7935  "In R613 c_action_part_ref() id = %s on line %d hasSelectionSubscriptList = %s hasImageSelector = %s \n",
7936  id->text, id->line,
7937  hasSelectionSubscriptList ? "true" : "false",
7938  hasImageSelector ? "true" : "false");
7939 
7940  // Pei-Hung (06/20/2019) the previous code here is moved to R612 (c_action_data_ref())
7941  // Only id is pushed to astNameStack and have everything else resolved in R612.
7942 
7943  // DQ (12/29/2010): These should be kept in sync (or at least there shuld be one astNameStack
7944  // entry for each astHasSelectionSubscriptStack entry. But maybe not the other way around.
7945  astNameStack.push_front(id);
7946  astHasSelectionSubscriptStack.push_front(hasSelectionSubscriptList);
7947 
7948  // DQ (12/29/2010): Enforce our new rule (fails for test2007_17.f90).
7949  // ROSE_ASSERT(astNameStack.size() == astHasSelectionSubscriptStack.size());
7950 
7951  // DQ (12/29/2010): Stand up redundant stack to replace use of astNameStack and astHasSelectionSubscriptStack in R612 and R613 handling.
7952  SgName id_name = id->text;
7953  astMultipartReferenceStack.push_front(
7954  MultipartReferenceType(id_name, hasSelectionSubscriptList,
7955  hasImageSelector));
7956 
7957 #if 0
7958  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
7959  outputState("At BOTTOM of R613 c_action_part_ref()");
7960 #endif
7961  }

9387  void c_action_and_operand(ofp_bool hasNotOp, int numAndOps)
9388  {
9389  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
9390  printf("In c_action_and_operand(): hasNotOp = %s numAndOps = %d \n",
9391  hasNotOp ? "true" : "false", numAndOps);
9392 
9393 #if !SKIP_C_ACTION_IMPLEMENTATION
9394 
9395  bool processRelationalOperator = hasNotOp || (numAndOps > 0);
9396  // bool processRelationalOperator = (numAndOps > 0);
9397  // if (astNameStack.empty() == false)
9398  if (processRelationalOperator == true)
9399  {
9400  ROSE_ASSERT(astNameStack.empty() == false);
9401  Token_t* relOp = astNameStack.front();
9402  // astNameStack.pop_front();
9403  ROSE_ASSERT(relOp != NULL);
9404 
9405  ROSE_ASSERT(relOp->text != NULL);
9406  // printf ("relOp->text = %s \n",relOp->text);
9407 
9408  // ROSE_ASSERT( (hasNotOp == true && numAndOps == 0) || (hasNotOp == false && numAndOps > 0) );
9409 
9410  // Support for chained relational operators
9411 
9412  // This will be right-associative instead of left-associative
9413  // which is required, but I will fix that afterward.
9414  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == false);
9415  SgExpression* rhs = astExpressionStack.front();
9416  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
9417 
9418  SgExpression* tempExpression = rhs;
9419  SgExpression* result = NULL;
9420  for (int i = 0; i < numAndOps; i++)
9421  {
9422  // Then this is a BINARY operator (.AND.)
9423  relOp = astNameStack.front();
9424  astNameStack.pop_front();
9425  // printf ("relOp->text = %s (should be .AND.)\n",relOp->text);
9426  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == false);
9427  SgExpression* lhs = astExpressionStack.front();
9428  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
9429 
9430  // This applies only to the first operand (which is a special case, and last on the stack since it was pushed first)
9431  if (i == numAndOps - 1 && hasNotOp == true)
9432  {
9433  // Then this is a UNARY operator (.NOT.)
9434  Token_t* local_relOp = astNameStack.front();
9435  // printf ("local_relOp->text = %s (should be .NOT.)\n",local_relOp->text);
9436  ROSE_ASSERT(local_relOp != NULL);
9437  lhs = createUnaryOperator(lhs, local_relOp->text, /* is_user_defined_operator */
9438  false);
9439  setSourcePosition(lhs, local_relOp);
9440 
9441  astNameStack.pop_front();
9442  }
9443 
9444  ROSE_ASSERT(relOp != NULL);
9445  result = createBinaryOperator(lhs, tempExpression, relOp->text, /* is_user_defined_operator */
9446  false);
9447  setSourcePosition(result, relOp);
9448 
9449  tempExpression = result;
9450  }
9451 
9452  // This applies only to the first operand (which is a special case, and last on the stack since it was pushed first)
9453  if (numAndOps == 0 && hasNotOp == true)
9454  {
9455  // Then this is a UNARY operator (.NOT.)
9456  ROSE_ASSERT(relOp != NULL);
9457  // printf ("relOp->text = %s (should be .NOT.)\n",relOp->text);
9458  result = createUnaryOperator(rhs, relOp->text, /* is_user_defined_operator */
9459  false);
9460  setSourcePosition(result, relOp);
9461 
9462  astNameStack.pop_front();
9463  }
9464 
9465  ROSE_ASSERT(result != NULL);
9466  astExpressionStack.push_front(result);
9467  }
9468 #endif
9469 #if 0
9470  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
9471  outputState("At BOTTOM of R714 c_action_and_operand()");
9472 #endif
9473  }

11139  void c_action_if_stmt(Token_t *label, Token_t *ifKeyword)
11140  {
11141  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
11142  printf("In R807 c_action_if_stmt() label = %p = %s \n", label,
11143  label ? label->text : "NULL");
11144 
11145  // This rule is for statements of the sort: "if (a) b = 0" without an associated endif statement.
11146 
11147 #if 1
11148  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
11149  outputState("At TOP of R807 c_action_if_stmt()");
11150 #endif
11151 
11152 #if !SKIP_C_ACTION_IMPLEMENTATION
11153  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == false);
11154 
11155  SgExpression* conditionalExpression = getTopOfExpressionStack();
11156  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
11157 
11158  SgExprStatement* conditionalStatement = new SgExprStatement(
11159  conditionalExpression);
11160 
11161  // setSourcePosition(conditionalStatement);
11162  ROSE_ASSERT(ifKeyword != NULL);
11163  setSourcePosition(conditionalStatement, ifKeyword);
11164 
11165  SgIfStmt* ifStatement = isSgIfStmt(astScopeStack.front()->get_parent());
11166  ROSE_ASSERT(ifStatement != NULL);
11167  ifStatement->set_conditional(conditionalStatement);
11168 
11169  // DQ (12/7/2010): Mark to not use the "then" keyword (this is the default).
11170  ifStatement->set_use_then_keyword(false);
11171 
11172  // DQ (11/17/2007): Added support for numeric labels
11173  setStatementNumericLabel(ifStatement, label);
11174 
11175  if (label != NULL)
11176  {
11177  ROSE_ASSERT(ifStatement->get_numeric_label() != NULL);
11178  }
11179 
11180  // DQ (11/17/2007): Get the source position from the "if" keyword.
11181  setSourcePosition(ifStatement, ifKeyword);
11182 
11183  SgBasicBlock* body = isSgBasicBlock(astScopeStack.front());
11184  ROSE_ASSERT(body != NULL);
11185 
11186  SgStatementPtrList & statementList = body->get_statements();
11187  SgStatementPtrList::iterator i = statementList.begin();
11188  while (i != statementList.end())
11189  {
11190  // Clear the numeric labels in the block of an if-statement (should have only a single statement)
11191  // If that had been R803, we would not clear the labels since that if construct has a block where
11192  // the statements in the block can have labels.
11193  (*i)->set_numeric_label(NULL);
11194  i++;
11195  }
11196 
11197  // DQ (10/10/2010): Test ending position
11198  ROSE_ASSERT(astScopeStack.front()->get_endOfConstruct() != NULL);
11199 
11200  SgStatement* lastStatement = astScopeStack.front()->lastStatement();
11201  // printf ("In c_action_if_stmt(): lastStatement = %p \n",lastStatement);
11202  ROSE_ASSERT(lastStatement != NULL);
11203  resetEndingSourcePosition(astScopeStack.front(), lastStatement);
11204 
11205  ROSE_ASSERT(astScopeStack.front()->get_endOfConstruct()->get_line() != astScopeStack.front()->get_startOfConstruct()->get_line());
11206 
11207  // Now pop the SgBasicBlock
11208  astScopeStack.pop_front();
11209 
11210  // DQ (10/10/2010): Test ending position
11211  ROSE_ASSERT(astScopeStack.front()->get_endOfConstruct() != NULL);
11212 
11213  SgStatement* nextLastStatement = astScopeStack.front()->lastStatement();
11214  // printf ("In c_action_if_stmt(): nextLastStatement = %p \n",nextLastStatement);
11215  ROSE_ASSERT(nextLastStatement != NULL);
11216  resetEndingSourcePosition(astScopeStack.front(), nextLastStatement);
11217 
11218  // DQ (10/10/2010): See example test2007_17.f90 of if statment on a single line for were we can't enforce this.
11219  // ROSE_ASSERT(astScopeStack.front()->get_endOfConstruct()->get_line() != astScopeStack.front()->get_startOfConstruct()->get_line());
11220 
11221  SgIfStmt* topOfStack_ifStatement = isSgIfStmt(astScopeStack.front());
11222  ROSE_ASSERT(topOfStack_ifStatement != NULL);
11223  ROSE_ASSERT(ifStatement == topOfStack_ifStatement);
11224 
11225  // This should be a simple if-stmt without and endif statement.
11226  ROSE_ASSERT(ifStatement->get_has_end_statement() == false);
11227 
11228  // Pop the if scope (it is a scope in C/C++, even if not in Fortran)
11229  // treating it as a scope will allow it to be consistent across C,C++, and Fortran.
11230  astScopeStack.pop_front();
11231 
11232  // printf ("CLEAR THE astLabelSymbolStack (c_action_if_stmt) \n");
11233  astLabelSymbolStack.clear();
11234 #endif
11235 
11236  // DQ (11/26/2007): This should be empty now. Check to make sure that we have not left trash on the stack.
11237  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == true);
11238 
11239 #if 1
11240  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
11241  outputState("At BOTTOM of R807 c_action_if_stmt()");
11242 #endif
11243  }

11336 void c_action_case_stmt(Token_t* label, Token_t* caseKeyword, Token_t* id, Token_t* /*eos*/)
11337  {

11340  << " caseKeyword = " << caseKeyword << " = " << (caseKeyword ? caseKeyword->text : "NULL")

11349 
11350  if (getCaseStmt()->isDefault)
11351  {

11353  if (id != NULL) defaultOptionStmt->set_default_construct_name(id->text);
11354 
11355  caseOrDefaultStatement = defaultOptionStmt;
11356  }
11357  else
11358  {
11359  SgExprListExp* key = getCaseStmt()->key;
11360  SgCaseOptionStmt* caseOptionStmt = SageBuilder::buildCaseOptionStmt_nfi(key, body);
11361 
11362  if (id != NULL) caseOptionStmt->set_case_construct_name(id->text);

11364  caseOrDefaultStatement = caseOptionStmt;

11375 #if 0

11380  // DQ (9/6/2010): Added error checking to support test2010_39.f90 test code.

11383  ROSE_ASSERT(astScopeStack.front()->get_parent() != NULL);
11384  SgWhereStatement* whereStatement = isSgWhereStatement(astScopeStack.front()->get_parent());
11385  SgIfStmt* ifStatement = isSgIfStmt(astScopeStack.front()->get_parent());
11386  if (whereStatement != NULL || ifStatement != NULL)
11387  {
11388  // If in a where statement produced with R 619:section-subscript-list__begin then the
11389  // condition is on the stack, else if it was produced with R744:where-construct-stmt
11390  // then the condition was used directly and already cleared from the stack.
11391  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.size() <= 1);
11392  }
11393  else
11394  {
11395  // If this is NOT a where statement then the stack should be empty.
11396  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == true);
11397  }
11398 
11399  // finished with this CaseStmt instance
11400  getCaseStmt()->reset();

11468 
11469  if (caseValueRange->hasSuffix) {
11470  // If c_action_case_value_range_suffix is called there is a colon
11471  hasColon = true;
11472  }
11473 
11474  if (hasColon == false)
11475  {
11476  // There is only a lower-bound (lb)
11477  range = caseValueRange->values[0];
11478  }
11479  else
11480  {
11481  // There is a colon, could be (lb:), (:ub), or (lb:ub)
11482 
11483  // A stride is necessary to build an SgSubscriptExpression
11484  SgExpression* stride = new SgIntVal(1,"1");
11485  SageInterface::setSourcePosition(stride);
11486 
11487  if (caseValueRange->hasSuffix == false)
11488  {
11489  // There is no lower-bound (:ub)
11490  ROSE_ASSERT(caseValueRange->numValues == 1);
11491  lowerBound = SageBuilder::buildNullExpression_nfi();
11492  upperBound = caseValueRange->values[0];
11493  }
11494  else if (caseValueRange->hasSuffix && (caseValueRange->hasSuffixExpr == false))
11495  {
11496  ROSE_ASSERT(caseValueRange->numValues == 1);
11497  lowerBound = caseValueRange->values[0];
11498  upperBound = SageBuilder::buildNullExpression_nfi();
11499  }
11500  else
11501  {
11502  ROSE_ASSERT(caseValueRange->numValues == 2);
11503  lowerBound = caseValueRange->values[0];
11504  upperBound = caseValueRange->values[1];
11505  }
11506 
11507  range = SageBuilder::buildSubscriptExpression_nfi(lowerBound, upperBound, stride);
11508  }
11509 
11510  ROSE_ASSERT(range);
11511  getCaseStmt()->key->get_expressions().push_back(range);
11512 
11513  // Finished with this CaseValueRange instance
11514  caseValueRange->reset();
11515  }

11912  Token_t *digitString, Token_t *eos, ofp_bool hasLoopControl)
11913  {
11914  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
11915  {
11916  printf("In c_action_do_stmt(): hasLoopControl = %s \n",
11917  hasLoopControl ? "true" : "false");
11918  printf(" label = %p = %s \n", label,
11919  (label != NULL) ? label->text : "NULL");
11920  printf(" id = %p = %s \n", id,
11921  (id != NULL) ? id->text : "NULL");
11922  printf(" doKeyword = %p = %s \n", doKeyword,
11923  (doKeyword != NULL) ? doKeyword->text : "NULL");
11924  printf(" digitString = %p = %s \n", digitString,
11925  (digitString != NULL) ? digitString->text : "NULL");
11926  printf(" eos = %p = %s \n", eos,
11927  (eos != NULL) ? eos->text : "NULL");
11928  }
11929 
11930  // This has to work for "DO i=1,100", "DO WHILE", and "DO CONCURRENT(i=1:100:2)
11931 
11932  // At this point for "DO I = 1, 100" the expressions for "I", "1", and "100" are on the astExpressionStack.
11933 
11934  bool buildWhileLoop = false;
11935  bool buildDoConcurrentLoop = false;
11936 
11937  SgExpression* indexExpression = NULL;
11938  SgExpression* endingIndex = NULL;
11939  SgExpression* stride = NULL;
11940  SgExpression* predicate = NULL;
11941  SgExprListExp* loopHeader = NULL;
11942 
11943  if (hasLoopControl == true)
11944  {
11945  // We have a "DO 123 I=1, 100, 4" style loop, where the digit string 123 and stride 4 are optional.
11946  if (astExpressionStack.size() == 3)
11947  {
11948  // There is a stride expression on the top of the stack
11949  stride = astExpressionStack.front();
11950  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
11951  }
11952 
11953  if (astExpressionStack.size() == 2)
11954  {
11955  // There are ending and starting indices on astExpressionStack and the index variable on astNameStack
11956  endingIndex = astExpressionStack.front();
11957  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
11958 
11959  SgExpression* startingIndex = astExpressionStack.front();
11960  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
11961 
11962  Token_t* variableToken = astNameStack.front();
11963  ROSE_ASSERT(astNameStack.empty() == false);
11964  SgName variableName = variableToken->text;
11965  astNameStack.pop_front();
11966 
11967  // DQ (1/18/2011): This detects where we have used the semantics of implicitly building symbols for implicit variables.
11968  // printf ("WARNING: This use of trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_variable_symbol() used the side effect of building a symbol if the reference is not found! \n");
11969  // ROSE_ASSERT(false);
11970 
11971  SgVariableSymbol* variableSymbol =
11972  trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_variable_symbol(
11973  variableName, astScopeStack.front());
11974  // ROSE_ASSERT(variableSymbol != NULL);
11975  if (variableSymbol == NULL)
11976  {
11977  // DQ (1/19/2011): Build the implicit variable
11978  buildImplicitVariableDeclaration(variableName);
11979 
11980  // Now verify that it is present.
11981  variableSymbol
11982  = trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_variable_symbol(
11983  variableName, astScopeStack.front());
11984  ROSE_ASSERT(variableSymbol != NULL);
11985  }
11986  ROSE_ASSERT(variableSymbol != NULL);
11987  SgExpression* index = new SgVarRefExp(variableSymbol);
11988  setSourcePosition(index, variableToken);
11989 
11990  // The index expression is the "I=1" part (which is built so that we can hand it to the SgFortranDo constructor)
11991  indexExpression = new SgAssignOp(index, startingIndex, NULL);
11992 
11993  // Note that the "=" does not exist as a token in OFP
11994  // setSourcePosition(indexExpression);
11995  ROSE_ASSERT(doKeyword != NULL);
11996  setSourcePosition(indexExpression, doKeyword);
11997 
11998  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == true);
11999  }
12000  else
12001  {
12002  if (astExpressionStack.size() == 1)
12003  {
12004  // This is the case of a "DO WHILE" loop, with the condition on the astExpressionStack...
12005  buildWhileLoop = true;
12006  predicate = astExpressionStack.front();
12007  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
12008  }
12009  else if (astExpressionStack.size() == 0)
12010  {
12011  // This is the case of a "DO CONCURRENT" loop, with the expression list astNodeStack...
12012  // Note that this may also apply to a "FORALL" loop but it has been make obsolete in the
12013  // standard so ignoring for now [Rasmussen 2019.08.23]
12014  buildDoConcurrentLoop = true;
12015  loopHeader = isSgExprListExp(astNodeStack.front());
12016  ROSE_ASSERT(loopHeader != NULL);
12017  astNodeStack.pop_front();
12018  }

12020  {
12021  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.

12023  printf(
12024  "Error: astExpressionStack.size() incorrect for do_stmt astExpressionStack.size() = %" PRIuPTR " \n",

12030 #if 0

12040 
12041  // We have a simpler "DO" style loop, there are no expressions on the stack to get
12042  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == true);
12043 
12044  indexExpression = new SgNullExpression();
12045  endingIndex = new SgNullExpression();
12046  stride = new SgNullExpression();

12048  setSourcePosition(indexExpression);
12049  setSourcePosition(endingIndex);
12050  setSourcePosition(stride);

12058 
12059  setSourcePosition(body);

12061  // SgStatement* loopStatement = NULL;

12063 
12064  if (buildWhileLoop == true)
12065  {
12066  ROSE_ASSERT(indexExpression == NULL);
12067  ROSE_ASSERT(endingIndex == NULL);
12068  ROSE_ASSERT(stride == NULL);
12069 
12070  ROSE_ASSERT(predicate != NULL);
12071  SgExprStatement* expressionStatement = new SgExprStatement(predicate);
12072 
12073  // setSourcePosition(expressionStatement,doKeyword);
12074  setSourcePosition(expressionStatement);
12075  resetSourcePosition(expressionStatement, predicate);

12077  SgWhileStmt* whileStatement = new SgWhileStmt(expressionStatement, body);

12079  // DQ (11/28/2010): Added specification of case insensitivity for Fortran.

12088  setStatementEndNumericLabel(whileStatement, digitString);
12089 
12090  whileStatement->set_has_end_statement(true);
12091 
12092  loopStatement = whileStatement;
12093  }
12094  else if (buildDoConcurrentLoop == true)

12096  ROSE_ASSERT(loopHeader != NULL);
12097 
12098  SgForAllStatement* doConcurrent = new SgForAllStatement(loopHeader, body);
12099  ROSE_ASSERT(doConcurrent != NULL);
12100 
12101  doConcurrent->set_forall_statement_kind(SgForAllStatement::e_do_concurrent_statement);

12106  loopStatement = doConcurrent;

12115  stride = new SgNullExpression();

12117  }

12122  fortranDo->setCaseInsensitive(true);

12125  // DQ (12/24/2007): Default to true and then if we see the c_action_end_do_stmt we can set it to false.
12126  // fortranDo->set_old_style(true);
12127 
12128  // printf ("In R827 c_action_do_stmt(): fortranDo = %p body = %p \n",fortranDo,body);
12129 
12130  // outputState("At stage 1 of R827 c_action_do_stmt()");
12131  // DQ (11/17/2007): Added support for numeric labels
12132  setStatementNumericLabel(fortranDo, label);

12151  body->set_parent(loopStatement);
12152  // Liao 2/1/2011, set the body's endOfConstruct to be the same as the loop statement's endOfConstruct
12153  // We should not use the endOfConstruct of fortran loop here since c_action_end_do_stmt()
12154  // will call resetEndingSourcePosition() to change it later on.
12155  // body->set_endOfConstruct (new Sg_File_Info(*(loopStatement->get_endOfConstruct())));
12156  // body->get_endOfConstruct()->set_line(6);
12157  astScopeStack.front()->append_statement(loopStatement);
12158 
12159  // Set or clear the astLabelSymbolStack (since it is redundant with the label being passed in)
12160  // There are two mechanisms used to set labels, and we never know which will be used by OFP.
12161  setStatementNumericLabelUsingStack(loopStatement);
12162 
12163  ROSE_ASSERT(loopStatement->get_parent() == astScopeStack.front());
12164 
12165  // DQ (12/25/2007): Made the FortranDo a SgScopeStatement to be uniform with other loop constructs.
12166  // So now we want to push the loopStatement onto the astScopeStack.
12167  astScopeStack.push_front(loopStatement);
12168  astScopeStack.push_front(body);
12169 
12170  ROSE_ASSERT(body->get_parent() == loopStatement);
12171

12367  {

12374  // This rule can be called even where the end-do does not exist (in this case, the endKeyword == NULL).

12407 
12408  // This is repeated code from R834
12409  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_COMMENT_LEVEL)

12414  label != NULL ? label->text : "NULL");
12415  printf(" endKeyword = %p = %s \n", endKeyword,

12418  doKeyword != NULL ? doKeyword->text : "NULL");

12426  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.

12430  // This rule can be called even where the end-do does not exist (in this case, the endKeyword == NULL).
12431  if (endKeyword != NULL)
12432  {
12433  // There is a valid "end do" statement in the source code, so mark this as a do statement using the new (F90) syntax.
12434  // printf ("***** Calling markDoLoopAsUsingEndDo() from c_action_do_term_action_stmt() \n");
12435  markDoLoopAsUsingEndDo();

12867  void c_action_continue_stmt(Token_t* label, Token_t* continueKeyword, Token_t* /*eos*/)
12868  {
12869  // A Fortran "CONTINUE" statement is mapped to a C "label" statement, so we use the existing SgLabelStatement IR node.
12870 
12871  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
12872  printf(
12873  "In c_action_continue_stmt(): label = %p = %s continueKeyword = %p = %s \n",

12875  continueKeyword != NULL ? continueKeyword->text : "NULL");
12876 
12877 #if 0
12878  outputState("At TOP of R848 c_action_continue_stmt()");
12879 #endif
12880 
12881  SgName name = label != NULL ? label->text : "";
12882  // printf ("In c_action_continue_stmt(): name of SgLabelStatement = %s \n",name.str());
12883  SgLabelStatement* labelStatement = new SgLabelStatement(name, NULL);
12884 
12885  ROSE_ASSERT(continueKeyword != NULL);
12886  if (label != NULL)
12887  {
12888  setStatementNumericLabel(labelStatement, label);
12889  }
12890  else
12891  {
12892  // printf ("In c_action_continue_stmt(): astLabelSymbolStack.empty() = %s \n",astLabelSymbolStack.empty() ? "true" : "false");
12893  if (astLabelSymbolStack.empty() == false)
12894  {
12895  SgLabelSymbol *labelSymbolFromStack = astLabelSymbolStack.front();
12896  astLabelSymbolStack.pop_front();
12897 
12898  // Mark this as a regular numerical label (in columns 2-6) and not associated with an else statement or an end statement.
12899  labelSymbolFromStack->set_label_type(
12900  SgLabelSymbol::e_start_label_type);
12901 
12902  SgLabelRefExp* labelRefExp = new SgLabelRefExp(labelSymbolFromStack);
12903  labelStatement->set_numeric_label(labelRefExp);
12904  labelRefExp->set_parent(labelStatement);
12905  setSourcePosition(labelRefExp);
12906 
12907  // Reset the statement referenced by this label (was previously referenced to a
12908  // statement which referenced it but was not that statement's numerical_label).
12909  labelSymbolFromStack->set_fortran_statement(labelStatement);
12910  }
12911  else
12912  {
12913  // printf ("Warning: No label found in argument to c_action_continue_stmt() and astLabelSymbolStack.empty() == true \n");
12914  }
12915  }
12916 
12917  // DQ (12/9/2007): set the scope.
12918  // labelStatement->set_scope(astScopeStack.front());
12919  SgFunctionDefinition* currentFunctionScope =
12920  TransformationSupport::getFunctionDefinition(astScopeStack.front());
12921  ROSE_ASSERT(currentFunctionScope != NULL);
12922  labelStatement->set_scope(currentFunctionScope);
12923  ROSE_ASSERT(labelStatement->get_scope() != NULL);
12924 
12925 #if 0
12926  outputState("Middle of R848 c_action_continue_stmt(, before adding SgLabelStatement to the top of the scope stack:)");
12927 #endif
12928 
12929  if (continueKeyword->line > 0) // DXN:FIXME workaround OFP bug
12930  {
12931  ROSE_ASSERT(astScopeStack.empty() == false);
12932  astScopeStack.front()->append_statement(labelStatement);
12933  }
12934  if (continueKeyword->line == 0)
12935  {
12936  // DXN: FIXME - workaround OFP bug where label->line = 0 as in the following example:
12937  /* subroutine FOURT()
12938  * DO 125 I1=1, 2
12939  * DO 125 I3= 3, 4
12940  * 125 CONTINUE
12941  * END
12942  *
12943  * When label is parsed the second time around, label->line = 0 and label->col = -1
12944  */
12945  continueKeyword->line
12946  = astScopeStack.front()->get_startOfConstruct()->get_line();
12947  continueKeyword->col
12948  = astScopeStack.front()->get_startOfConstruct()->get_col();
12949  labelStatement->set_parent(astScopeStack.front());
12950  }
12951  setSourcePosition(labelStatement, continueKeyword);
12952 
12953  // DQ (12/16/2007): A label had been pushed onto the stack, but it is redundant with the label provided as a token.
12954  if (label != NULL)
12955  {
12956  // outputState("Before astNameStack.pop_front() in R848 c_action_continue_stmt()");
12957  ROSE_ASSERT(astLabelSymbolStack.empty() == false);
12958  astLabelSymbolStack.pop_front();
12959  }
12960  else
12961  {
12962  // The label is not always passed into the continue statement
12963  if (astLabelSymbolStack.empty() == false)
12964  {
12965  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_COMMENT_LEVEL)
12966  printf(
12967  "Warning: found a LabelSymbol on the stack, but it was not passed into the c_action_continue_stmt() \n");
12968 
12969  astLabelSymbolStack.pop_front();
12970  }
12971  }
12972 
12973  // DQ (10/10/2010): Mark the end of the do loop scope using the continueKeyword token.
12974  ROSE_ASSERT(continueKeyword != NULL);
12975  resetEndingSourcePosition(astScopeStack.front(), continueKeyword);
12976 
12977 #if 0

13442  void c_action_close_stmt(Token_t *label, Token_t *closeKeyword, Token_t*)
13443  {
13444  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
13445  printf(
13446  "In c_action_close_stmt(): label = %p = %s closeKeyword = %p = %s \n",
13447  label, label != NULL ? label->text : "NULL", closeKeyword,
13448  closeKeyword != NULL ? closeKeyword->text : "NULL");

13450  SgCloseStatement* closeStatement = new SgCloseStatement();
13451  ROSE_ASSERT(closeStatement != NULL);
13452

13454  // setSourcePosition(closeStatement);

13456  setSourcePosition(closeStatement, closeKeyword);
13457 
13458 #if 1
13459  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
13460  outputState("At BOTTOM of R908 c_action_close_stmt()");
13461 #endif
13462 
13463  // DQ (9/6/2010): Switch to using the astNameStack since there can be an additional
13464  // expression on the astExpressionStack due to an if stmt predicate (see test2010_40.f90).
13465  // printf ("Warning: Ignoring all but the 'unit' in the OpenStatement \n");
13466  // while (astExpressionStack.empty() == false)

13468  {

13470  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == false);
13471 
13472  SgExpression* expression = astExpressionStack.front();

13475  // We don't need the current_IO_Control_Spec data structure in the code below.
13476 
13477  // The "unit=" string is optional, if it was not present then a toekn was pushed onto the stack with the text value "defaultString"
13478  if (strncasecmp(name->text, "unit", 4) == 0 || strncmp(name->text,
13479  "defaultString", 13) == 0)
13480  {
13481  closeStatement->set_unit(expression);
13482  }
13483  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "iostat", 6) == 0)
13484  {
13485  closeStatement->set_iostat(expression);

13487  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "err", 3) == 0)
13488  {
13489  // closeStatement->set_err(expression);

13491  SgExpression* labelRefExp = buildLabelRefExp(expression);
13492  ROSE_ASSERT(labelRefExp != NULL);
13493  closeStatement->set_err(labelRefExp);
13494  labelRefExp->set_parent(closeStatement);
13495  }
13496  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "status", 6) == 0)
13497  {
13498  closeStatement->set_status(expression);
13499  }
13500  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "iomsg", 5) == 0)
13501  {
13502  closeStatement->set_iomsg(expression);
13503  }
13504 
13505  astNameStack.pop_front();
13506  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
13507 
13508  expression->set_parent(closeStatement);
13509  }
13510 
13511  setStatementNumericLabel(closeStatement, label);
13512 
13513  // DQ (12/8/2010): Added label handling support for the redundant label stack.
13514  processLabelOnStack(closeStatement);
13515 
13516  astScopeStack.front()->append_statement(closeStatement);
13517  }

13573 void c_action_read_stmt(Token_t* label, Token_t* readKeyword, Token_t* /*eos*/, ofp_bool hasInputItemList)
13574  {
13575  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
13576  printf(
13577  "In c_action_read_stmt(): label = %p = %s readKeyword = %p = %s hasInputItemList = %s \n",
13578  label, label != NULL ? label->text : "NULL", readKeyword,
13579  readKeyword != NULL ? readKeyword->text : "NULL",
13580  hasInputItemList ? "true" : "false");
13581 
13582  SgReadStatement* readStatement = new SgReadStatement();
13583  ROSE_ASSERT(readStatement != NULL);
13584  ROSE_ASSERT(readKeyword != NULL);
13585  setSourcePosition(readStatement, readKeyword);
13586 
13587  setStatementNumericLabel(readStatement, label);
13588 
13589  // DQ (12/19/2007): This is a more uniform handling of the SgExprListExp (computed in R915)
13590  // SgExprListExp* exprListExp = isSgExprListExp(astExpressionStack.front());
13591  SgExprListExp* exprListExp = NULL;
13592  if (astExpressionStack.empty() == false)
13593  {
13594  // DQ (9/6/2010): This is used in test2007_109.f90
13595  exprListExp = isSgExprListExp(astExpressionStack.front());
13596 
13597  // DQ (9/6/2010): Handle the case of empty input-item-list (see test2010_40.f90)
13598  // astExpressionStack.pop_front();
13599  // ROSE_ASSERT(exprListExp != NULL);
13600  if (exprListExp == NULL)
13601  {
13602  exprListExp = new SgExprListExp();
13603  setSourcePosition(exprListExp);
13604  }
13605  else
13606  {
13607  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
13608  ROSE_ASSERT(exprListExp != NULL);
13609  }
13610  }
13611  else
13612  {
13613  // DQ (12/30/2007): This is the trivial case where no input items have been specified (e.g. "read *")
13614  exprListExp = new SgExprListExp();
13615  setSourcePosition(exprListExp);
13616  }
13617 
13618  ROSE_ASSERT(exprListExp != NULL);
13619  readStatement->set_io_stmt_list(exprListExp);
13620  exprListExp->set_parent(readStatement);
13621 
13622 #if 1
13623  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
13624  outputState(
13625  "After processing the numberOfVariables in R910 c_action_read_stmt()");
13626 #endif
13627 
13628  // If there is only one entry then it is the unit, not the format.
13629  int initialStackDepth = astExpressionStack.size();
13630 
13631  // printf ("In R910 c_action_read_stmt(): initialStackDepth = %d \n",initialStackDepth);
13632 
13633  // If this list is empty then there was nothing specified, as reported by OFP, but this is the case of "read *, ..." so we will interpret this as the case of "read fmt=*. ..." or "read *, ..."
13634  bool availableFormatSpecifier = astNameStack.empty();
13635  if (availableFormatSpecifier == true)
13636  {
13637  // There was no option recorded by OFP, so this means that "*" was used (OFP bug, I think).
13638  // So push the asterisk, and record it as the fmt option.
13639  SgAsteriskShapeExp* asterisk = new SgAsteriskShapeExp();
13640  setSourcePosition(asterisk);
13641 
13642  astExpressionStack.push_front(asterisk);
13643 
13644  // This is the case of an option not being specified, as in "read(1)" instead of "read(UNIT=1)"
13645  // To make the astExpressionStack match the astNameStack we have to push a default token onto the astNameStack.
13646  Token_t* defaultToken = create_token(0, 0, 0, "fmt");
13647  ROSE_ASSERT(defaultToken != NULL);
13648  astNameStack.push_front(defaultToken);
13649  }
13650 
13651  // astExpressionStack.pop_front();
13652  // printf ("Warning: Ignoring all but the 'unit' in the OpenStatement \n");
13653  // while (astExpressionStack.empty() == false)
13654  while (astNameStack.empty() == false)
13655  {
13656  // ROSE_ASSERT(astNameStack.empty() == false);
13657  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == false);
13658 
13659  SgExpression* expression = astExpressionStack.front();
13660  Token_t* name = astNameStack.front();
13661 
13662  // Pop these off immediately, so that we look ahead in the stack!
13663  astNameStack.pop_front();
13664  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
13665 
13666  Token_t* lookAheadName = NULL;
13667  if (astNameStack.empty() == false)
13668  {
13669  // This is required for cases such as: "read (1,asynchronous='YES') array", see test2007_123.f03.
13670  lookAheadName = astNameStack.front();
13671  }
13672  // printf ("In c_action_read_stmt(): processing token = %s with expression = %p = %s lookAheadName = %p \n",name->text,expression,expression->class_name().c_str(),lookAheadName);
13673 
13674 #if 1
13675  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
13676  outputState("In loop over io-control-list in R910 c_action_read_stmt()");
13677 #endif
13678 
13679  // We don't need the current_IO_Control_Spec data structure in the code below.
13680 
13681  // The "unit=" string is optional, if it was not present then a token was pushed onto the stack with the text value "defaultString"
13682  // if ( (strncasecmp(name->text,"fmt",3) == 0) || (strncmp(name->text,"defaultString",13) == 0) && (readStatement->get_format() == NULL) )
13683  // if ( (strncasecmp(name->text,"fmt",3) == 0) || ( (strncmp(name->text,"defaultString",13) == 0) && (readStatement->get_format() == NULL) && (initialStackDepth >= 2) ) )
13684  if ((strncasecmp(name->text, "fmt", 3) == 0) || ((strncmp(name->text,
13685  "defaultString", 13) == 0) && (readStatement->get_format()
13686  == NULL) && (initialStackDepth >= 2) && (lookAheadName != NULL
13687  && strncmp(lookAheadName->text, "defaultString", 13) == 0)))
13688  {
13689  // printf ("Processing token = %s as format spec \n",name->text);
13690  // DQ (12/3/2010): This code fails for test2007_211.f.
13691  ROSE_ASSERT(expression != NULL);
13692  SgExpression* labelRefExp = buildLabelRefExp(expression);
13693  ROSE_ASSERT(labelRefExp != NULL);
13694  // printf ("In c_action_read_stmt(): readStatement->set_format(%p = %s) \n",labelRefExp,labelRefExp->class_name().c_str());
13695  readStatement->set_format(labelRefExp);
13696  labelRefExp->set_parent(readStatement);
13697 
13698  ROSE_ASSERT(expression->get_parent() != NULL);
13699  }
13700  // Process this second because the unit expression is deeper on the stack!
13701  else if ( ((strncasecmp(name->text, "unit", 4) == 0)
13702  || (strncmp(name->text, "defaultString", 13) == 0))
13703  && (readStatement->get_unit() == NULL) )
13704  {
13705  // printf ("Processing token = %s as unit spec expression = %s \n",name->text,expression->class_name().c_str());
13706  readStatement->set_unit(expression);
13707  }
13708  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "iostat", 6) == 0)
13709  {
13710  // printf ("Processing token = %s as iostat spec expression = %s \n",name->text,expression->class_name().c_str());
13711  readStatement->set_iostat(expression);
13712  }
13713  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "err", 3) == 0)
13714  {
13715  // readStatement->set_err(expression);
13716  ROSE_ASSERT(expression != NULL);
13717  SgExpression* labelRefExp = buildLabelRefExp(expression);
13718  ROSE_ASSERT(labelRefExp != NULL);
13719  readStatement->set_err(labelRefExp);
13720  labelRefExp->set_parent(readStatement);
13721  }
13722  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "rec", 3) == 0)
13723  {
13724  readStatement->set_rec(expression);
13725  }
13726  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "iomsg", 5) == 0)
13727  {
13728  readStatement->set_iomsg(expression);
13729  }
13730  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "end", 3) == 0)
13731  {
13732  // readStatement->set_end(expression);
13733  ROSE_ASSERT(expression != NULL);
13734  SgExpression* labelRefExp = buildLabelRefExp(expression);
13735  ROSE_ASSERT(labelRefExp != NULL);
13736  readStatement->set_end(labelRefExp);
13737  labelRefExp->set_parent(readStatement);
13738  }
13739  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "nml", 3) == 0)
13740  {
13741  readStatement->set_namelist(expression);
13742  }
13743  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "advance", 7) == 0)
13744  {
13745  readStatement->set_advance(expression);
13746  }
13747  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "size", 4) == 0)
13748  {
13749  readStatement->set_size(expression);
13750  }
13751  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "eor", 3) == 0)
13752  {
13753  ROSE_ASSERT(expression != NULL);
13754  SgExpression* labelRefExp = buildLabelRefExp(expression);
13755  ROSE_ASSERT(labelRefExp != NULL);
13756  readStatement->set_eor(labelRefExp);
13757  labelRefExp->set_parent(readStatement);
13758  }
13759  else if (strncasecmp(name->text, "asynchronous", 12) == 0)
13760  {
13761  readStatement->set_asynchronous(expression);
13762  }
13763 
13764  expression->set_parent(readStatement);
13765 
13766 #if 1
13767  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
13768  outputState(
13769  "BOTTOM of loop over io-control-list in R910 c_action_read_stmt()");
13770 #endif
13771  }
13772 
13773  ROSE_ASSERT(readStatement != NULL);
13774 
13775  setStatementNumericLabel(readStatement, label);
13776 
13777  processLabelOnStack(readStatement);
13778 
13779  // ROSE_ASSERT(readStatement->get_format() != NULL);
13780  // printf ("At BOTTOM of R910 c_action_read_stmt(): FMT = %p = %s \n",readStatement->get_format(),readStatement->get_format()->class_name().c_str());
13781  astScopeStack.front()->append_statement(readStatement);
13782 
13783 #if 1
13784  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
