13797 void c_action_write_stmt(Token_t* label, Token_t* writeKeyword, Token_t* /*eos*/, ofp_bool hasOutputItemList)
13798  {
13799  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
13800  printf(
13801  "In c_action_write_stmt(): label = %p = %s writeKeyword = %p = %s hasOutputItemList = %s \n",
13802  label, label != NULL ? label->text : "NULL", writeKeyword,
13803  writeKeyword != NULL ? writeKeyword->text : "NULL",
13804  hasOutputItemList ? "true" : "false");
13805 
13806  SgWriteStatement* writeStatement = new SgWriteStatement();
13807  ROSE_ASSERT(writeStatement != NULL);
13808  ROSE_ASSERT(writeKeyword != NULL);
13809  setSourcePosition(writeStatement, writeKeyword);
13810 
13811  setStatementNumericLabel(writeStatement, label);
13812 
13813  writeStatement->set_io_statement(SgIOStatement::e_write);
13814 
13815  // Rasmussen (05/30/2019): Extensive rewrite to fix error in processing the io_control_spec_list
13816  //
13817  SgExprListExp* exprListExp = isSgExprListExp(astExpressionStack.front());
13818 
13819  if (exprListExp == NULL)
13820  {
13821  // This is a case where there is nothing to write (see test2007_221.f)
13822  // so make an empty list.
13823  exprListExp = new SgExprListExp();
13824  setSourcePosition(exprListExp);
13825  }
13826  else
13827  {
13828  // If we got the SgExprListExp from the stack then we pop the stack (but only then)
13829  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
13830  }
13831 
13832  ROSE_ASSERT(exprListExp != NULL);
13833 
13834  writeStatement->set_io_stmt_list(exprListExp);
13835  exprListExp->set_parent(writeStatement);
13836 
13837  // Remove items from the io_control_spec_list that aren't specifically named.
13838  // These are potentially {unit,fmt,nml}. They are associated with the name
13839  // "defaultString" and order matters. Which io_control_spec they belong to
13840  // will be sorted out last after processing the named ones (not "defaultString").
13841  // Regarding order:
13842  // 1. If unit is not named it shall be the first item in the list (and shall be present).
13843  // 2. If nml is not named and appears in the list (as a namelist) it shall be the second item after unit.
13844  // 3. If fmt is not named it shall be the second item in the list following unit.
13845  // 4. There shall not be both a format spec and a namelist spec.
13846 
13847  std::vector<SgExpression*> unnamed_spec_list;
13848 
13849  bool has_unit_spec = false;
13850  bool has_format_spec = false;
13851  bool has_nml_spec = false;
13852 
13853  ROSE_ASSERT(astNameStack.size() <= astExpressionStack.size());
13854 
13855  while (astNameStack.empty() == false)
13856  {
13857  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == false);
13858 
13859  SgExpression* spec_expr = astExpressionStack.front();
13860  Token_t* spec_name = astNameStack.front();
13861 
13862  ROSE_ASSERT(spec_expr != NULL);
13863 
13864  // Handle the unnamed case (with name "defaultString") by storing the expression in a list
13865  if ( strncmp(spec_name->text, "defaultString", 13) == 0 )
13866  {
13867  unnamed_spec_list.push_back(spec_expr);
13868  }
13869  else if ( strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "unit", 4) == 0 )
13870  {
13871  has_unit_spec = true;
13872  writeStatement->set_unit(spec_expr);
13873  }
13874  else if ( strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "fmt", 3) == 0 )
13875  {
13876  has_format_spec = true;
13877  if (isSgIntVal(spec_expr) != NULL)
13878  {
13879  SgExpression* labelRefExp = buildLabelRefExp(spec_expr);
13880  ROSE_ASSERT(labelRefExp != NULL);
13881  writeStatement->set_format(labelRefExp);
13882  labelRefExp->set_parent(writeStatement);
13883  }
13884  else if ( isSgStringVal (spec_expr) != NULL ||
13885  isSgVarRefExp (spec_expr) != NULL ||
13886  isSgFunctionCallExp (spec_expr) != NULL || // can occur when trim is used for a character string
13887  isSgAsteriskShapeExp(spec_expr) != NULL )
13888  {
13889  writeStatement->set_format(spec_expr);
13890  }
13891  else
13892  {
13893  fprintf (stderr, "In c_action_write_stmt(): ERROR processing token = %s with spec_expr of class = %s \n",
13894  spec_name->text, spec_expr->class_name().c_str());
13895  ROSE_ABORT();
13896  }
13897  }
13898  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "nml", 3) == 0)
13899  {
13900  has_nml_spec = true;
13901  writeStatement->set_namelist(spec_expr);
13902  }
13903  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "advance", 7) == 0)
13904  {
13905  writeStatement->set_advance(spec_expr);
13906  }
13907  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "asynchronous", 12) == 0)
13908  {
13909  writeStatement->set_asynchronous(spec_expr);
13910  }
13911  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "blank", 5) == 0)
13912  {
13913  writeStatement->set_blank(spec_expr);
13914  }
13915  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "decimal", 7) == 0)
13916  {
13917  writeStatement->set_decimal(spec_expr);
13918  }
13919  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "delim", 5) == 0)
13920  {
13921  writeStatement->set_delim(spec_expr);
13922  }
13923  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "end", 3) == 0)
13924  {
13925  ROSE_ASSERT(spec_expr != NULL);
13926  SgExpression* labelRefExp = buildLabelRefExp(spec_expr);
13927  ROSE_ASSERT(labelRefExp != NULL);
13928  writeStatement->set_end(labelRefExp);
13929  labelRefExp->set_parent(writeStatement);
13930  }
13931  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "eor", 3) == 0)
13932  {
13933  ROSE_ASSERT(spec_expr != NULL);
13934  SgExpression* labelRefExp = buildLabelRefExp(spec_expr);
13935  ROSE_ASSERT(labelRefExp != NULL);
13936  writeStatement->set_eor(labelRefExp);
13937  labelRefExp->set_parent(writeStatement);
13938  }
13939  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "err", 3) == 0)
13940  {
13941  ROSE_ASSERT(spec_expr != NULL);
13942  SgExpression* labelRefExp = buildLabelRefExp(spec_expr);
13943  ROSE_ASSERT(labelRefExp != NULL);
13944  writeStatement->set_err(labelRefExp);
13945  labelRefExp->set_parent(writeStatement);
13946  }
13947  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "id", 2) == 0)
13948  {
13949  writeStatement->set_id(spec_expr);
13950  }
13951  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "iomsg", 5) == 0)
13952  {
13953  writeStatement->set_iomsg(spec_expr);
13954  }
13955  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "iostat", 6) == 0)
13956  {
13957  writeStatement->set_iostat(spec_expr);
13958  }
13959  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text,"pad",3) == 0)
13960  {
13961  writeStatement->set_pad(spec_expr);
13962  }
13963  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text,"pos",3) == 0)
13964  {
13965  writeStatement->set_pos(spec_expr);
13966  }
13967  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "rec", 3) == 0)
13968  {
13969  writeStatement->set_rec(spec_expr);
13970  }
13971  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "round", 5) == 0)
13972  {
13973  writeStatement->set_round(spec_expr);
13974  }
13975  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "sign", 4) == 0)
13976  {
13977  writeStatement->set_sign(spec_expr);
13978  }
13979  else if (strncasecmp(spec_name->text, "size", 4) == 0)
13980  {
13981  writeStatement->set_size(spec_expr);
13982  }
13983  else
13984  {
13985  fprintf (stderr, "In c_action_write_stmt(): ERROR processing token = %s with spec_expr of class = %s \n",
13986  spec_name->text, spec_expr->class_name().c_str());
13987  ROSE_ABORT();
13988  }
13989 
13990  astNameStack.pop_front();
13991  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
13992 
13993  // Always set the parent of the spec_expr so we won't have to do it later in processing the unnamed_spec_list
13994  spec_expr->set_parent(writeStatement);
13995  }
13996 
13997  // Now process the unnamed spec items (they are in reverse order because they came from a stack)
13998  //
13999  int num_unnamed = unnamed_spec_list.size();
14000 
14001  // There are a maximum of two spec items in the list
14002  ROSE_ASSERT(num_unnamed <= 2);
14003 
14004  // If the io-spec has already been seen there can be only one item on the list
14005  if (has_unit_spec) ROSE_ASSERT(num_unnamed <= 1);
14006 
14007  // Get spec expressions in reverse order (recall they came from a stack)
14008  SgExpression* spec_expr_1 = (num_unnamed >= 1) ? unnamed_spec_list[num_unnamed - 1] : NULL;
14009  SgExpression* spec_expr_2 = (num_unnamed == 2) ? unnamed_spec_list[0] : NULL;
14010 
14011  // We have to keep track of the spec expression that isn't an io-unit
14012  // (if has_unit_spec=true it is has been named with "unit=" and is not on the unnamed list)
14013  SgExpression* spec_expr_other = (has_unit_spec) ? spec_expr_1 : spec_expr_2;
14014 
14015  // Handle the unit spec first as it must be present and first on the list (if not specified by name).
14016  if (has_unit_spec == false)
14017  {
14018  ROSE_ASSERT(spec_expr_1 != NULL);
14019  writeStatement->set_unit(spec_expr_1);
14020  has_unit_spec = true;
14021  spec_expr_1 = NULL;
14022  }
14023 
14024  // Now check for a namelist as it can only be a name (SgVarRefExp) and thus different from a format spec
14025  SgVarRefExp* nml_expr = (has_nml_spec == false) ? isSgVarRefExp(spec_expr_other) : NULL;
14026  if (nml_expr != NULL)
14027  {
14028  // Make sure this variable isn't a string, if so it is a format spec
14029  SgType* type = nml_expr->get_type();
14030  ROSE_ASSERT(type);
14031  SgTypeString* string_type = isSgTypeString(type);
14032  if (string_type == NULL) {
14033  writeStatement->set_namelist(nml_expr);
14034  has_nml_spec = true;
14035  spec_expr_other = NULL;
14036  }
14037  }
14038 
14039  // Check for a format spec as a label (SgIntVal)
14040  SgIntVal* fmt_label_expr = (has_format_spec == false) ? isSgIntVal(spec_expr_other) : NULL;
14041  if (fmt_label_expr != NULL)
14042  {
14043  SgExpression* labelRefExp = buildLabelRefExp(fmt_label_expr);
14044  ROSE_ASSERT(labelRefExp != NULL);
14045  writeStatement->set_format(labelRefExp);
14046  labelRefExp->set_parent(writeStatement);
14047  has_format_spec = true;
14048  spec_expr_other = NULL;
14049  }
14050 
14051  // Check for a format spec as a string, variable, function call (e.g., trim), or '*'
14052  SgExpression* fmt_expr = NULL;
14053  if (has_format_spec == false)
14054  {
14055  if ( isSgStringVal (spec_expr_other) != NULL ||
14056  isSgVarRefExp (spec_expr_other) != NULL ||
14057  isSgFunctionCallExp (spec_expr_other) != NULL || // can occur when trim is used for character string
14058  isSgAsteriskShapeExp(spec_expr_other) != NULL )
14059  {
14060  fmt_expr = spec_expr_other;
14061  ROSE_ASSERT(fmt_expr);
14062  writeStatement->set_format(fmt_expr);
14063  has_format_spec = true;
14064  spec_expr_other = NULL;
14065  }
14066  }
14067 
14068  // Hopefully we are done!
14069  //
14070  if (spec_expr_other != NULL)
14071  {
14072  printf ("In c_action_write_stmt(): ERROR: DID NOT process class name %s \n", spec_expr_other->class_name().c_str());
14073  printf (" assuming this is a name-list-spec gone wrong, examine and try test pr17285.f90 \n");
14074  // test pr17285.f90 has a namelist that appears as a SgFunctionRefExp
14075  // TODO - fix this - but for now let it be a name-list
14076 
14077  printf ("--- recovering by processing expression class name %s as nml spec \n", spec_expr_other->class_name().c_str());
14078  writeStatement->set_namelist(spec_expr_other);
14079  has_nml_spec = true;
14080  spec_expr_other = NULL;
14081  }
14082 
14083  ROSE_ASSERT(has_unit_spec);
14084  ROSE_ASSERT(spec_expr_1 == NULL && spec_expr_other == NULL);
14085 
14086  setStatementNumericLabel(writeStatement, label);
14087 
14088  processLabelOnStack(writeStatement);
14089 
14090  astScopeStack.front()->append_statement(writeStatement);
14091 
14092  // Set or clear the astLabelSymbolStack (since it is redundant with the label being passed in)
14093  // There are two mechanisms used to set labels, and we never know which will be used by OFP.
14094  setStatementNumericLabelUsingStack(writeStatement);
14095 
14096  // Error checking: there may still be something on the stack from an unhandled implied do loop
14097  // when we have a correctly handled implied do loop (there are three flavors) this should not be required.
14098  if (astExpressionStack.empty() == false)
14099  {
14100  // DQ (12/12/2010): Make this a warning only output within verbose mode.
14101  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > 0) {
14102  printf("WARNING: unfinished implied do loop expressions may be left on stack (or from a c_action_if_stmt()) (write)\n");
14103  }
14104  }
14105  }

14336  void c_action_format()
14337  {
14338  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
14339  printf("In c_action_format() \n");
14340 
14341  // DQ (12/3/2010): I think this is the problem with test2007_211.f. Namely we have to push a name ("fmt") on the the astNamestack!
14342 
14343 #if 1
14344  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
14345  outputState("At TOP of R914 c_action_format()");
14346 #endif
14347 
14348  if (astExpressionStack.empty() == true)
14349  {
14350  // If there was nothing pushed to the stack, then push the SgAsteriskShapeExp ???
14351  // I think we are just borrowing the fact that this expression will output a "*" and
14352  // perhaps we should have a specialized expression more specific to format semantics.
14353  SgExpression* asteriskExpression = new SgAsteriskShapeExp();
14354  setSourcePosition(asteriskExpression);
14355  astExpressionStack.push_front(asteriskExpression);
14356 
14357  push_token("fmt");
14358  }
14359  else
14360  {
14361  // Note that if this is a scalar-logical-expression, then the expression is likely from a if-stmt and not a part of a format statement.
14362  SgExpression* expressionOnStack = astExpressionStack.front();
14363 
14364  // Using a switch statement allows us to more cleanly handle a growing number of special cases.
14365  // printf ("expressionOnStack = %p = %s \n",expressionOnStack,expressionOnStack->class_name().c_str());
14366  switch (expressionOnStack->variantT())
14367  {
14368  // Handle case of format label (integer): print 1, N
14369  case V_SgIntVal:
14370 
14371  // Handle case of format string: print "(a, i8)", "a = ", N (see test2010_123.f90).
14372  case V_SgStringVal:
14373 
14374  // Handle case of format string (formed from string concatination): print "(a, "||" i8)", "a = ", N (see test2010_124.f90).
14375  case V_SgConcatenationOp:
14376  {
14377  push_token("fmt");
14378  break;
14379  }
14380 
14381  // Handle case of format string (passed as a variable): CHARACTER(len=*) :: fmtstr; PRINT fmtstr, str (see test2010_125.f90).
14382  case V_SgVarRefExp:
14383  {
14384  // printf ("expressionOnStack->get_type() = %p = %s \n",expressionOnStack->get_type(),expressionOnStack->get_type()->class_name().c_str());
14385  SgTypeString* stringType = isSgTypeString(
14386  expressionOnStack->get_type());
14387  // ROSE_ASSERT(stringType != NULL);
14388  if (stringType != NULL)
14389  {
14390  push_token("fmt");
14391  }
14392  break;
14393  }
14394 
14395  default:
14396  {
14397  // Add no "fmt" token.
14398  printf(
14399  "Non integer scalars can NOT be used in format statements so ignore this (no fmt pushed onto astNameStack). \n");
14400  }
14401  }
14402  }
14403 
14404 #if 1
14405  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
14406  outputState("At BOTTOM of R914 c_action_format()");
14407 #endif
14408  }

14542  void c_action_io_implied_do()
14543  {
14544  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
14545  printf("c_action_io_implied_do() \n");
14546 
14547 #if 1
14548  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
14549  outputState("At TOP of R917 c_action_io_implied_do()");
14550 #endif
14551 
14552  // Note that non-unit stride is not allowed here, I think.
14553 
14554  // The implied_do_control is at the top of the stack
14555  SgExpression* implied_do_control_temp = astExpressionStack.front();
14556  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
14557 
14558  SgExprListExp* implied_do_control =
14559  isSgExprListExp(implied_do_control_temp);
14560  ROSE_ASSERT(implied_do_control != NULL);
14561 
14562  // DQ (1/31/2011): The typical value is two unless the stride is included (in which case it is three).
14563  // DQ (10/9/2010): This improved design uses a single expression to hold the do loop variable initialization.
14564  // ROSE_ASSERT(implied_do_control->get_expressions().size() == 2);
14565  ROSE_ASSERT(implied_do_control->get_expressions().size() == 2 || implied_do_control->get_expressions().size() == 3);
14566 
14567  SgExpression* doLoopVarInitialization =
14568  implied_do_control->get_expressions()[0];
14569  ROSE_ASSERT(doLoopVarInitialization != NULL);
14570 
14571  SgExpression* upperBound = implied_do_control->get_expressions()[1];
14572  ROSE_ASSERT(upperBound != NULL);
14573 
14574  // DQ (1/31/2011): Added the case of where a stride is explicitly specified (see test2010_160.f90).
14575  SgExpression* stride = NULL;
14576  if (implied_do_control->get_expressions().size() == 3)
14577  {
14578  stride = implied_do_control->get_expressions()[2];
14579  ROSE_ASSERT(stride != NULL);
14580  }
14581  // printf ("Stride set to stride = %p \n",stride);
14582 
14583  implied_do_control->get_expressions().clear();
14584  delete implied_do_control;
14585  implied_do_control = NULL;
14586 
14587  SgExpression* increment = NULL;
14588  if (stride != NULL)
14589  {
14590  // printf ("Setting the io_implied do loop intrement using the stride = %p = %s taken from the stack. \n",stride,stride->class_name().c_str());
14591  increment = stride;
14592  }
14593  else
14594  {
14595  increment = new SgNullExpression();
14596  ROSE_ASSERT(increment != NULL);
14597  setSourcePosition(increment);
14598  }
14599  ROSE_ASSERT(increment != NULL);
14600 
14601  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == false);
14602  // printf ("In R917 c_action_io_implied_do(): astExpressionStack.front() = %s \n",astExpressionStack.front()->class_name().c_str());
14603  SgExprListExp* objectList = isSgExprListExp(astExpressionStack.front());
14604  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
14605

14753  // setSourcePosition(assignment);
14754 
14755  // DQ (10/9/2010): Reimplementation of support for implied do loop support.
14756  // We have to form the implied do loop variable initialization. Note that this is not
14757  // a variable declaration, since if implicit none is used, the variable must have
14758  // already been declared.
14759  ROSE_ASSERT(astNameStack.empty() == false);
14760  SgName do_variable_name = astNameStack.front()->text;
14761  astNameStack.pop_front();
14762 
14763  // printf ("implied do loop variable name = %s \n",do_variable_name.str());

14765  // DQ (1/18/2011): This detects where we have used the semantics of implicitly building symbols for implicit variables.
14766  // printf ("WARNING: This use of trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_variable_symbol() used the side effect of building a symbol if the reference is not found! \n");
14767  // ROSE_ASSERT(false);

14769  SgVariableSymbol* variableSymbol =
14770  trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_variable_symbol(
14771  do_variable_name, astScopeStack.front());
14772 
14773  // If this was an implicit variable then variableSymbol would be NULL, but the variable would have
14774  // been built as a side-effect of calling trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_variable_symbol().
14775  // So now we have to call it again.
14776 
14777  // Note that the location of the scope of the definition of the implicit implied do index will
14778  // later be a special scope stored in the implied do loop IR node.
14779  if (variableSymbol == NULL)
14780  {
14781  // DQ (1/19/2011): Build the implicit variable
14782  buildImplicitVariableDeclaration(do_variable_name);
14783 
14784  // Now verify that it is present.
14785  variableSymbol
14786  = trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_variable_symbol(
14787  do_variable_name, astScopeStack.front());
14788  ROSE_ASSERT(variableSymbol != NULL);
14789  }
14790 
14791  // Now we can assert that this should be a pointer to a valid symbol.
14792  ROSE_ASSERT(variableSymbol != NULL);
14793 
14794  SgVarRefExp* doLoopVar = SageBuilder::buildVarRefExp(variableSymbol);
14795  ROSE_ASSERT(doLoopVar != NULL);
14796 
14797  SgExpression* doVariableInitialization = SageBuilder::buildAssignOp(
14798  doLoopVar, lowerBound);
14799  ROSE_ASSERT(doVariableInitialization != NULL);
14800  // printf ("doVariableInitialization = %p = %s \n",doVariableInitialization,doVariableInitialization->class_name().c_str());
14801 
14802  SgExprListExp* implied_do_control = new SgExprListExp();
14803  ROSE_ASSERT(implied_do_control != NULL);
14804 
14805  // implied_do_control->append_expression(doLoopVar);
14806  implied_do_control->append_expression(doVariableInitialization);
14807  // implied_do_control->append_expression(lowerBound);
14808  implied_do_control->append_expression(upperBound);
14809 
14810  if (stride != NULL)
14811  {
14812  implied_do_control->append_expression(stride);
14813  ROSE_ASSERT(implied_do_control->get_expressions().size() == 3);
14814  }
14815  else
14816  {
14817  ROSE_ASSERT(implied_do_control->get_expressions().size() == 2);
14818  }
14819 
14820  astExpressionStack.push_front(implied_do_control);

16031  void c_action_program_stmt(Token_t *label, Token_t *programKeyword, Token_t *id, Token_t*)
16032  {
16033  // If this is called then we want to mark the SgProgramHeaderStatement (derived from a SgFunctionDeclaration)
16034  // as explicit in the source code (using the tokens to communicate the source position information)
16035  // Also need to make the SgFunctionDefinition and the SgBasicBlock (function body) as being explicit
16036  // in the source code.
16037 
16038  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
16039  printf("In c_action_program_stmt(): label = %s id = %s \n",
16040  label ? label->text : "NULL", id ? id->text : "NULL");
16041 
16042  ROSE_ASSERT(id != NULL);
16043 
16044 #if !SKIP_C_ACTION_IMPLEMENTATION
16045  SgScopeStatement* topOfStack = getTopOfScopeStack();
16046  ROSE_ASSERT(topOfStack->variantT() == V_SgGlobal);
16047 
16048  // Inconsistency to fix: notice that we are pusing tokens to the back of the tokenList and scopes
16049  // to the front of the astScopeStack. This is however a local scope (local scope).
16050  TokenListType tokenList;
16051  if (label != NULL)
16052  tokenList.push_back(label);
16053  tokenList.push_back(id);
16054 
16055  ROSE_ASSERT(id != NULL);
16056  ROSE_ASSERT(id->text != NULL);
16057 
16058  SgName programName = id->text;
16059 
16060  // We should test if this is in the function type table, but do this later
16061  SgFunctionType* functionType = new SgFunctionType(SgTypeVoid::createType(), false);
16062 
16063 #if 0
16064  // DQ (10/11/2014): Added extra parameter to resolve ambiguity as a result of changing which are marked as constructor parameter in ROSETTA.
16065  SgProgramHeaderStatement* programDeclaration = new SgProgramHeaderStatement(programName, NULL, functionType, NULL);
16066 #else
16067  SgProgramHeaderStatement* programDeclaration = new SgProgramHeaderStatement(programName, functionType, NULL);
16068 #endif
16069  // This is the defining declaration and there is no non-defining declaration!
16070  programDeclaration->set_definingDeclaration(programDeclaration);
16071 
16072  programDeclaration->set_scope(topOfStack);
16073  programDeclaration->set_parent(topOfStack);
16074 
16075  // Add the program declaration to the global scope
16076  // topOfStack->append_statement(programDeclaration);
16077  SgGlobal* globalScope = isSgGlobal(topOfStack);
16078  ROSE_ASSERT(globalScope != NULL);
16079  globalScope->append_statement(programDeclaration);
16080 
16081  // A symbol using this name should not already exist
16082  ROSE_ASSERT(!globalScope->symbol_exists(programName));
16083 
16084  // Add a symbol to the symbol table in global scope
16085  SgFunctionSymbol* symbol = new SgFunctionSymbol(programDeclaration);
16086  globalScope->insert_symbol(programName, symbol);
16087 
16088  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_COMMENT_LEVEL)
16089  printf("Inserted SgFunctionSymbol in globalScope using name = %s \n",
16090  programName.str());
16091 
16092  // Add a symbol to the symbol table in global scope
16093  // SgFunctionTypeSymbol* symbol = new SgFunctionTypeSymbol(programDeclaration,functionType);
16094  // globalScope->insert_symbol(programName, symbol);
16095 
16096  // This statement, like all statements, could have a numeric label.
16097  // Setup the label on the statement if it is available.
16098  // setStatementNumericLabel(programDeclaration,label);
16099 
16100  SgBasicBlock* programBody = new SgBasicBlock();
16101  SgFunctionDefinition* programDefinition = new SgFunctionDefinition(programDeclaration, programBody);
16102 
16103  programBody->setCaseInsensitive(true);
16104  programDefinition->setCaseInsensitive(true);
16105 
16106  astScopeStack.push_front(programDefinition);
16107  astScopeStack.push_front(programBody);
16108 
16109  programBody->set_parent(programDefinition);
16110  programDefinition->set_parent(programDeclaration);
16111 
16112  // DQ (12/9/2007): Moved so that the label's symbol can be put into the function
16113  // definition's scope. See test2007_01.f90.
16114  setStatementNumericLabel(programDeclaration, label);
16115 
16116  ROSE_ASSERT(programDeclaration->get_parameterList() != NULL);
16117 
16118  if (programKeyword != NULL)
16119  {
16120  setSourcePosition(programDeclaration->get_parameterList(),
16121  programKeyword);
16122  setSourcePosition(programDeclaration, programKeyword);
16123  }
16124  else
16125  {
16126  // These will be marked as isSourcePositionUnavailableInFrontend = true and isOutputInCodeGeneration = true
16127 
16128  // DQ (12/18/2008): These need to make marked with a valid file id (not NULL_FILE, internally),
16129  // so that any attached comments and CPP directives will be properly attached.
16130  setSourcePosition(programDeclaration->get_parameterList(), tokenList);
16131  setSourcePosition(programDeclaration, tokenList);
16132  }
16133 
16134  // Unclear if we should use the same token list for resetting the source position in all three IR nodes.
16135  setSourcePosition(programDefinition, tokenList);
16136  setSourcePosition(programBody, tokenList);
16137 
16138  // Set the program name
16139  programDeclaration->set_name(id->text);
16140 
16141  ROSE_ASSERT(programDeclaration->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration() != programDeclaration);
16142  ROSE_ASSERT(programDeclaration->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration() == NULL);
16143 #endif

16286  void c_action_end_module_stmt(Token_t* label, Token_t* endKeyword, Token_t* /*moduleKeyword*/,
16287  Token_t* id, Token_t* /*eos*/)
16288  {
16289  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL) {
16290  printf("In c_action_end_module_stmt(): id = %p = %s \n", id, id != NULL ? id->text : "NULL");
16291  }
16292 #if 1
16293  // Output debugging information about saved state (stack) information.
16294  outputState("At TOP of R1106 c_action_end_module_stmt()");
16295 #endif
16296 
16297  ROSE_ASSERT(astScopeStack.front() != NULL);
16298  SgModuleStatement* moduleStatement = isSgModuleStatement(
16299  astScopeStack.front()->get_parent());
16300  ROSE_ASSERT(moduleStatement != NULL);
16301 
16302  SgClassDefinition* moduleScope = isSgClassDefinition(astScopeStack.front());
16303  ROSE_ASSERT(moduleScope != NULL);
16304 
16305  // FMZ: 05/30/2008 add the subtree root to the map
16306  string fileName = moduleStatement->get_name();
16307 
16308  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
16309  printf("Creating a module file %s using module name = %s \n",
16310  StringUtility::convertToLowerCase(fileName).c_str(),
16311  fileName.c_str());
16312 
16313  fileName = StringUtility::convertToLowerCase(fileName);
16314 
16315  setStatementNumericLabel(moduleStatement, label);
16316 
16317  // DQ (10/10/2010): Test ending position
16318  ROSE_ASSERT(astScopeStack.empty() == false);
16319  ROSE_ASSERT(astScopeStack.front()->get_endOfConstruct() != NULL);
16320 
16321  // DQ (10/10/2010): Set the end position using the endKeyword.
16322  ROSE_ASSERT(endKeyword != NULL);
16323  resetEndingSourcePosition(astScopeStack.front(), endKeyword);
16324 
16325  ROSE_ASSERT(astScopeStack.front()->get_endOfConstruct()->get_line() != astScopeStack.front()->get_startOfConstruct()->get_line());
16326 
16327  // Pop the module's scope
16328  astScopeStack.pop_front();
16329 
16330  // DQ (5/21/2008): This should be cleared (see test2008_35.f90, where "public" is left on the stack)
16331  if (astNameStack.empty() == false)
16332  {
16333  printf(
16334  "Warning: entry remaining in name stack astNameStack.front() = %s \n",
16335  astNameStack.front()->text);
16336  }
16337  astNameStack.clear();
16338 
16339  SgClassDefinition* moduleDefinition = moduleStatement->get_definition();
16340  ROSE_ASSERT(moduleDefinition != NULL);
16341 
16342  // Note that there can be many interface statements in a module.
16343  std::vector<SgInterfaceStatement*> interfaceList =
16344  moduleStatement->get_interfaces();
16345  for (size_t i = 0; i < interfaceList.size(); i++)
16346  {
16347  SgInterfaceStatement* interfaceStatement = interfaceList[i];
16348 
16349  SgScopeStatement* currentScope = interfaceStatement->get_scope();
16350  ROSE_ASSERT(currentScope != NULL);
16351 
16352  // I think that this is true, enforce it!
16353  ROSE_ASSERT(currentScope == moduleDefinition);
16354 
16355  SgName interfaceName = interfaceStatement->get_name();
16356 
16357  // Note that there can be many function declarations (interface bodies) in each interface statement in a module.
16358  std::vector<SgInterfaceBody*> interfaceBodyList =
16359  interfaceStatement->get_interface_body_list();
16360 
16361  // Accumulate the new SgRenameSymbol nodes into a list and then add them after we are finished traversing the symbols in the current scope!
16362  std::vector<SgRenameSymbol*> renameSymbolList;
16363 
16364  for (size_t j = 0; j < interfaceBodyList.size(); j++)
16365  {
16366  SgInterfaceBody* interfaceBody = interfaceBodyList[j];
16367  if (interfaceBody->get_functionDeclaration() == NULL)
16368  {
16369  // Fixup the functionDeclaration in the interface body
16370  SgName functionName = interfaceBody->get_function_name();
16371 
16372  // printf ("Fixup functionName = %s in interfaceName = %s \n",functionName.str(),interfaceName.str());
16373 
16374  // DQ (9/29/2008): inject all symbols from the module's symbol table into symbol table at current scope.
16375  SgSymbol* symbol = moduleDefinition->first_any_symbol();
16376  while (symbol != NULL)
16377  {
16378  SgFunctionSymbol* functionSymbol = isSgFunctionSymbol(
16379  symbol);
16380 
16381  // I don't think that the mapped function in the interface has to be public.
16382  // if (isPubliclyAccessible(symbol) == true)
16383 
16384  if (functionSymbol != NULL)
16385  {
16386  // By definition we assume that the interface name is different from the function name
16387  // bool isRenamed = true;
16388  ROSE_ASSERT(interfaceName != functionName);
16389  ROSE_ASSERT(interfaceName != "");
16390 
16391  SgFunctionDeclaration* functionDeclaration =
16392  isSgFunctionDeclaration(
16393  functionSymbol->get_declaration());
16394  ROSE_ASSERT(functionDeclaration != NULL);
16395 
16396  // printf ("Found symbol for function = %s in interfaceName = %s \n",functionDeclaration->get_name().str(),interfaceName.str());
16397 
16398  if (functionDeclaration->get_name() == functionName)
16399  {
16400  // Set the previously NULL function declaration stored in the SgInterfaceBody
16401  interfaceBody->set_functionDeclaration(
16402  functionDeclaration);
16403 
16404  // DQ (10/8/2008): Build a symbol to map the function name to the name defined by the interface.
16405  // We might want to have a different sort of symbol for this purpose since the functionSymbol
16406  // and the aliasSymbol are in the same scope (where as previously the SgAliasSymbol has been
16407  // used to map symbols between scopes).
16408  // SgAliasSymbol* aliasSymbol = new SgAliasSymbol(functionSymbol,/* isRenamed = true */ true,interfaceName);
16409  // SgRenameSymbol* renameSymbol = new SgRenameSymbol(functionSymbol,interfaceName);
16410  SgRenameSymbol* renameSymbol = new SgRenameSymbol(
16411  functionSymbol->get_declaration(),
16412  functionSymbol, interfaceName);
16413 #if 1
16414  if (SgProject::get_verbose()
16415  > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
16416  printf(
16417  "R1106 Insert aliased symbol name = %s (renamed from functionName = %s )\n",
16418  interfaceName.str(), functionName.str());
16419 #endif
16420  // Accumulate the list of required SgRenameSymbol IR nodes, and add them after we finish the traversal over the current scops symbols
16421  // currentScope->insert_symbol(interfaceName,aliasSymbol);
16422  // currentScope->insert_symbol(interfaceName,renameSymbol);
16423  renameSymbolList.push_back(renameSymbol);
16424  }
16425  }
16426 
16427  // Look at the next symbol in the module's symbol table
16428  symbol = moduleDefinition->next_any_symbol();
16429  }
16430  }
16431  }
16432 
16433  // Insert the list of accumulated symbols into the current scope
16434  // printf ("renameSymbolList.size() = %" PRIuPTR " \n",renameSymbolList.size());
16435  for (size_t i = 0; i < renameSymbolList.size(); i++)
16436  {
16437  currentScope->insert_symbol(interfaceName, renameSymbolList[i]);
16438  }
16439  }
16440 
16441  // This is part of a bug fix demonstrated by test2010_32.f90.
16442  // DQ (8/28/2010): A function call in a module can apprea before it's declaration. This is supported by:
16443  // 1) building the function declaration
16444  // 2) Building a function symbol
16445  // 3) Put the function sysmbol into the global scope (since it is not clear where to put it)
16446  // 4) Fixup function symbols of referenced function calls in the module
16447  // printf ("Now process function references in the module to match against functions defined in the module scope! \n");
16448  // printf ("Current scope = %p = %s \n",moduleScope,moduleScope->class_name().c_str());
16449  fixupModuleScope(moduleScope);
16450  }

17013  void c_action_rename(Token_t *id1, Token_t *id2, Token_t *op1, Token_t *defOp1,
17014  Token_t *op2, Token_t *defOp2)
17015  {
17016  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
17017  printf(
17018  "In c_action_rename(): id1 = %p = %s id2 = %p = %s op1 = %p = %s defOp1 = %p = %s op2 = %p = %s defOp2 = %p = %s \n",
17019  id1, id1 != NULL ? id1->text : "NULL", id2,
17020  id2 != NULL ? id2->text : "NULL", op1,
17021  op1 != NULL ? op1->text : "NULL", defOp1,
17022  defOp1 != NULL ? defOp1->text : "NULL", op2,
17023  op2 != NULL ? op2->text : "NULL", defOp2,
17024  defOp2 != NULL ? defOp2->text : "NULL");
17025 
17026  // Construct the name pair used
17027  // SgRenamePair* renamePair = new SgRenamePair(id1->text,id2->text);
17028  SgRenamePair* renamePair = NULL;
17029  if (id1 != NULL && id2 != NULL)
17030  {
17031  // This is a simple variable or defined type renaming
17032  renamePair = new SgRenamePair(id1->text, id2->text);
17033 
17034  // Since there is more than one token used to define a rename, the source position is not accurately set using just "id1".
17035  setSourcePosition(renamePair, id1);
17036  }
17037  else
17038  {
17039  // This is the case of an operator renaming, note that op1 and op2 will contain the token "operator" if this
17040  // is an operator renaming. These should maybe be folded into the names that are input into the SgRenamePair.
17041  ROSE_ASSERT(defOp1 != NULL && defOp2 != NULL);
17042  ROSE_ASSERT(op1 != NULL && op2 != NULL);
17043 
17044  ROSE_ASSERT(id1 == NULL && id2 == NULL);
17045 
17046  string local_name = defOp1->text;
17047  string use_name = defOp2->text;
17048  if (op1 != NULL && op2 != NULL)
17049  {
17050  local_name = string(op1->text) + "(" + local_name + ")";
17051  use_name = string(op2->text) + "(" + use_name + ")";
17052  }
17053  else
17054  {
17055  // If they are not both valid pointers, make sure that they are both NULL, else we may have missed
17056  // some corner case for which I don't have a test code yet.
17057  ROSE_ASSERT(op1 == NULL && op2 == NULL);
17058  }
17059 
17060  renamePair = new SgRenamePair(local_name, use_name);
17061 
17062  // Since there is more than one token used to define a rename, the source position is not accurately set using just "id1".
17063  setSourcePosition(renamePair, defOp1);
17064  }
17065 
17066  ROSE_ASSERT(renamePair->get_file_info() != NULL);
17067 
17068  astNodeStack.push_front(renamePair);
17069 
17070  // Note that any variable reference to the name id1->text will use the alias symbol that will be built in later steps (R1109)
17071 #if 0
17072  outputState("At BOTTOM of R1111 c_action_rename()");
17073 #endif
17074  }

17135  void c_action_only_list(int count)
17136  {
17137  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
17138  printf("In c_action_only_list(): count = %d \n", count);
17139 
17140 #if 0
17141  outputState("At TOP of R1112 list c_action_only_list()");
17142 #endif
17143 
17144  // DQ (10/1/2008): Bug in OFP, discussed with Craig, will be fixed to permit
17145  // this value to be passed in (assume false for now). Remove this declaration
17146  // when the bug is fixed to have it be passed in via the parameter list.
17147  // ofp_bool hasRenameList = astNameStack.empty() ? false : true;
17148  ofp_bool hasRenameList = astNameStack.empty() ? true : false;
17149 
17150  // outputState("At TOP of R1112 list c_action_only_list()");
17151 
17152  // printf ("In c_action_only_list(): hasRenameList = %s \n",hasRenameList ? "true" : "false");
17153 
17154  // If we don't have a renameList then the tokens are on the astNameStack, else
17155  // they are already processed into SgRenamePair IR nodes and on the astNodeStack.
17156  if (hasRenameList == false)
17157  {
17158  // If there was not renaming, then build the SgRenamePair using empty names for the local name to signal
17159  // that there was no renaming. This permits a consistant interface when they are processed by R1109.
17160  // Pei-Hung (06/18/2019) renameList and generic name can co-exist in the same list
17161  // Since no renameList will exist in astNameStack, it should use the stack size here,
17162  // not the count from parser.
17163  int astNameStackSize = astNameStack.size();
17164  for (int i = 0; i < astNameStackSize; i++)
17165  {
17166  // Construct the name pair for the case of the "only" clause, where there is no renaming.
17167  ROSE_ASSERT(astNameStack.empty() == false);
17168  SgName name = astNameStack.front()->text;
17169 
17170  // printf ("In c_action_only_list(): Building SgRenamePair for name = %s (not renamed) \n",name.str());
17171  if (matchingName(name, "OPERATOR") == true)
17172  {
17173  // Then get the next token and append it to the name.
17174  astNameStack.pop_front();
17175  SgName operatorName = astNameStack.front()->text;
17176  name = operatorName;
17177  // printf ("In c_action_only_list() this is an operator: name = %s \n",name.str());
17178  }
17179 
17180  // Use the rename pir IR node to provide a uniform interface to the construction of the SgUseStatement, but set the local-name to be "".
17181  // SgRenamePair* renamePair = new SgRenamePair("",name);
17182  SgRenamePair* renamePair = new SgRenamePair(name, name);
17183 
17184  setSourcePosition(renamePair, astNameStack.front());
17185 
17186  ROSE_ASSERT(renamePair->get_file_info() != NULL);
17187 
17188  astNameStack.pop_front();
17189 
17190  astNodeStack.push_front(renamePair);
17191  }
17192  }
17193  else
17194  {
17195  // The SgRenamePair nodes should already be on the astNodeStack.
17196  ROSE_ASSERT(astNodeStack.empty() == false);
17197 
17198  if (astNameStack.empty() == false)
17199  {
17200  printf(
17201  "Error: rename list with only clause not supported yet, bug in OFP. \n");
17202  ROSE_ABORT();
17203  }
17204  ROSE_ASSERT(astNameStack.empty() == true);
17205  }
17206 #if 0
17207  outputState("At BOTTOM of R1112 list c_action_only_list()");
17208 #endif
17209  }

19245  void c_action_return_stmt(Token_t* label, Token_t* keyword, Token_t* /*eos*/,
19246  ofp_bool hasScalarIntExpr)
19247  {
19248  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
19249  printf(
19250  "In R1236 c_action_return_stmt(): label = %s hasScalarIntExpr = %s \n",
19251  (label != NULL) ? label->text : "NULL",
19252  hasScalarIntExpr ? "true" : "false");
19253 
19254  SgExpression* returnValue = NULL;
19255 
19256  // DQ (12/10/2016): Eliminating a warning that we want to be an error: -Werror=unused-but-set-variable.
19257  // bool returningFromFunctionUsingAlternativeReturnArguments = false;
19258 
19259  if (hasScalarIntExpr == true)
19260  {
19261 #if 0
19262  printf ("Warning: Need to get the correct expression value, returning zero \n");
19263  returnValue = new SgIntVal(0,"0");
19264 #else
19265  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == false);
19266  returnValue = astExpressionStack.front();
19267  astExpressionStack.pop_front();
19268  // setSourcePosition(returnValue,keyword);
19269  // setSourcePosition(returnValue);
19270 #endif
19271 
19272  SgInitializedName* argumentInitializedName = NULL;
19273  SgIntVal* integerValue = isSgIntVal(returnValue);
19274 
19275 #if 1
19276  // DQ (2/2/2011): Saving the return support for alternative return handling until tomorrow.
19277  if (integerValue != NULL)
19278  {
19279  // This might be a function with alternative return arguments (keep checking).
19280  size_t alternativeReturnValue = (size_t) integerValue->get_value();
19281 
19282  SgFunctionDefinition* functionDefinition =
19283  SageInterface::getEnclosingFunctionDefinition(
19284  astScopeStack.front(), /* includingSelf= */true);
19285  ROSE_ASSERT(functionDefinition != NULL);
19286 
19287  SgFunctionDeclaration* functionDeclaration =
19288  functionDefinition->get_declaration();
19289  ROSE_ASSERT(functionDeclaration != NULL);
19290 
19291  SgInitializedNamePtrList & args = functionDeclaration->get_args();
19292 
19293  // These is the only valid range of numbers allowed.
19294  if (alternativeReturnValue < 1 || alternativeReturnValue
19295  > args.size())
19296  {
19297  printf(
19298  "Error: alternativeReturnValue = %" PRIuPTR " is out of range for this function's parameter list \n",
19299  alternativeReturnValue);
19300  }
19301  ROSE_ASSERT(alternativeReturnValue > 0);
19302  ROSE_ASSERT(alternativeReturnValue <= args.size());
19303 
19304  // The Fortran world starts at one (not zero)!
19305  size_t counter = 1;
19306 
19307  for (size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); i++)
19308  {
19309  SgType* argumentType = args[i]->get_type();
19310  SgTypeLabel* labelType = isSgTypeLabel(argumentType);
19311  if (labelType != NULL)
19312  {
19313  if (counter == alternativeReturnValue)
19314  {
19315  argumentInitializedName = args[i];
19316  }
19317 
19318  counter++;
19319  }
19320  }
19321 
19322  if (argumentInitializedName != NULL)
19323  {
19324  // DQ (12/10/2016): Eliminating a warning that we want to be an error: -Werror=unused-but-set-variable.
19325  // returningFromFunctionUsingAlternativeReturnArguments = true;
19326 
19327  SgSymbol
19328  * tempSymbol =
19329  argumentInitializedName->search_for_symbol_from_symbol_table();
19330  ROSE_ASSERT(tempSymbol != NULL);
19331  SgLabelSymbol* labelSymbol = isSgLabelSymbol(tempSymbol);
19332  ROSE_ASSERT(labelSymbol != NULL);
19333 
19334  // Before we build the label reference expression delete the SgIntVal IR node.
19335  ROSE_ASSERT(returnValue != NULL);
19336  delete returnValue;
19337  returnValue = NULL;
19338 
19339  returnValue = new SgLabelRefExp(labelSymbol);
19340  setSourcePosition(returnValue);
19341  }
19342  else
19343  {
19344  // No need to change the set value above.
19345  ROSE_ASSERT(returnValue != NULL);
19346  }
19347  }
19348  else
19349  {
19350  // This could not be a function with alternative return arguments.
19351  // No need to change the set value above.
19352  ROSE_ASSERT(returnValue != NULL);
19353  }
19354 #endif
19355  }
19356  else
19357  {
19358  returnValue = new SgNullExpression();
19359 
19360  // The source position has to be set for this case only, since it is already set for where the value is on the stack (hasScalarIntExpr == true).
19361  setSourcePosition(returnValue);
19362  }
19363 
19364  // DQ (1/31/2010): This can't be set for both branches since it is already set for any expression on the stack.
19365  // setSourcePosition(returnValue);
19366 
19367  SgReturnStmt* returnStatement = new SgReturnStmt(returnValue);
19368  returnValue->set_parent(returnStatement);
19369 
19370  ROSE_ASSERT(keyword != NULL);
19371  setSourcePosition(returnStatement, keyword);
19372 
19373  // DQ (12/8/2010): Added label handling support for the redundant label stack.
19374  processLabelOnStack(returnStatement);
19375 
19376  setStatementNumericLabel(returnStatement, label);
19377 
19378  astScopeStack.front()->append_statement(returnStatement);
19379 
19380 #if 1

19382  outputState("At BOTTOM of R1236 c_action_return_stmt()");

19485  // DQ: This is the earliest location to setup the global scope (I think).

19488  // DXN: We create a SgFortranIncludeLine node only when the current file is not a top level file
19489  // and is not an rmod file. When parsing a top level file, the astIncludeStack should be empty.
19490  if (!astIncludeStack.empty() && !isARoseModuleFile(filepath))
19491  {

19494 
19495 #if ROSE_OFP_MINOR_VERSION_NUMBER >= 8 & ROSE_OFP_PATCH_VERSION_NUMBER >= 3
19496  SgFortranIncludeLine* includeLine = new SgFortranIncludeLine(filename);
19497 #else

19499 #endif
19500 
19501  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
19502  printf(
19503  "Note: Need a token to represent the filename so that we can get the position of the include statement\n");
19504

19506  SgScopeStatement* scope = astScopeStack.front();

19509  if (statementList.empty() == false)
19510  {
19511  lastStatement = statementList.back();
19512  }
19513 
19514  int
19515  lineNumberOfLastStatement =
19516  (astScopeStack.empty() == false) ? lastStatement->get_file_info()->get_line()
19517  : 0;
19518 
19519  // Increment to next line since an include must be on it's own line (as I understand the Fortran standard).
19520  lineNumberOfLastStatement++;
19521 
19522  int columnNumber = 0;
19523 
19524  // The filename where the include is located is not the filename specified with the include!
19525  string filenameOfIncludeLocation = getCurrentFilename();
19526 
19527  Sg_File_Info* fileInfo = new Sg_File_Info(filenameOfIncludeLocation,
19528  lineNumberOfLastStatement, columnNumber);

19530  // We need a way to get the source position of the Fortran include line.
19531  // setSourcePositionCompilerGenerated(includeLine);
19532  // setSourcePosition(includeLine);
19533  includeLine->set_file_info(fileInfo);
19534 
19535  // DQ (11/20/2010): Also set the end of the construct for this statement (end of column position is not correct).
19536  Sg_File_Info* ending_fileInfo = new Sg_File_Info(
19537  filenameOfIncludeLocation, lineNumberOfLastStatement,
19538  columnNumber);
19539  includeLine->set_endOfConstruct(ending_fileInfo);
19540 
19541  ROSE_ASSERT(includeLine->get_endOfConstruct() != NULL);

19547  // handling of the use statement, not the existance of the Fortran include

19550  ROSE_ASSERT(astScopeStack.empty() == false);
19551 
19552  // This does not always appear to be appending to the scope
19553  astScopeStack.front()->append_statement(includeLine);
19554  // patch up defining and non-defining pointers, Liao 12/7/2010
19555  includeLine->set_definingDeclaration(includeLine);
19556  includeLine->set_firstNondefiningDeclaration(includeLine);
19557  }

19561 #else

19563 #endif
19564

19568 #endif

19794  teamName = "team_world";

19801  }
19802  else
19803  teamName = "team_default";

19807  SgVariableSymbol * teamSymbol = trace_back_through_parent_scopes_lookup_variable_symbol(teamName, astScopeStack.front());

19809  {
19810  if( teamName == "team_world" || teamName == "team_default" )
19811  teamSymbol = add_external_team_decl(teamName);
19812  else
19813  cout << "FATAL ERROR: undeclared team variable '" << teamName << "' in allocate statement" << endl;
19814  }
19815  ROSE_ASSERT(teamSymbol);

19818  // convert expression on top of stack to a coarray-reference expression
19819

19821  astExpressionStack.pop_front();

19824  coExpr->set_parent(dataExpr->get_parent());
19825  dataExpr->set_parent(coExpr);
19826 
19827  astExpressionStack.push_front(coExpr);

19829  // set source positions of new constructs

19831  if( teamVarRef )
19832  { setSourcePosition(teamVarRef); resetSourcePosition(teamVarRef, dataExpr);}
19833  setSourcePosition(coExpr); resetSourcePosition(coExpr, dataExpr);

20010  void c_action_rice_spawn_stmt(Token_t* /*label*/, Token_t* spawn, Token_t* /*eos*/, ofp_bool hasEvent)
20011  {
20012 #if 0
20013  outputState("At TOP of c_action_rice_spawn_stmt()");

20016  // get the function reference and its arg list
20017 
20018  ROSE_ASSERT(spawn != NULL);

20020  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == false);
20021  SgFunctionCallExp * originalCallExpr = isSgFunctionCallExp(astExpressionStack.front());
20022  ROSE_ASSERT(originalCallExpr != NULL);// TODO: can we get a SgFunctionRefExp instead, if no actual param list given?
20023  astExpressionStack.pop_front();

20026  ROSE_ASSERT(functionRef != NULL);

20029  // get the notification event if any

20032  {
20033  ROSE_ASSERT(astExpressionStack.empty() == false);
20034  eventExpr = astExpressionStack.front();

20038  eventExpr = NULL;

20043  SgVarRefExp * teamExpr = rice_dataref_coexpr->get_teamId();

20045  rice_dataref_coexpr = NULL;
20046 
20047  // argument list
20048  c_action_section_subscript_list__begin();// R619
20049 
20050  // function to be spawned
20051  astExpressionStack.push_front(functionRef);
20052  c_action_section_subscript(true, false, false, true);// R619
20053 
20054  // original function arguments from source
20055  SgExpressionPtrList & argPtrs = argumentList->get_expressions();
20056  int num = argPtrs.size();
20057  for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
20058  {
20059  astExpressionStack.push_front(argPtrs[k]);
20060  c_action_section_subscript(true, false, false, true); // R619
20061  }
20062 
20063  // processor number
20064  astExpressionStack.push_front(pnumExpr);
20065  c_action_section_subscript(true, false, false, true);// R619
20066 
20067  // team id
20068  if (teamExpr != NULL)// R619
20069  astExpressionStack.push_front(teamExpr);
20070  else
20071  {
20072  SgExpression * nullExpr = new SgNullExpression();
20073  setSourcePosition(nullExpr, spawn);
20074  astExpressionStack.push_front(nullExpr);
20075  }
20076  c_action_section_subscript(true, false, false, true);
20077 
20078  // notification event
20079  if (hasEvent)// R619
20080  astExpressionStack.push_front(eventExpr);

20082  {
20083  SgExpression * nullExpr = new SgNullExpression();
20084  setSourcePosition(nullExpr, spawn);
20085  astExpressionStack.push_front(nullExpr);
20086  }
20087  c_action_section_subscript(true, false, false, true);
20088 
20089  // number of args = original number + 4 (f, p, t, e)
20090  c_action_section_subscript_list(num + 4);// R619
20091 
20092  // function call
20093  Token * caf_spawn_subr = create_token(spawn->line, spawn->col, 0,
20094  SPAWN_SUBR_NAME);
20095  c_action_part_ref(caf_spawn_subr, true, false);// R613
20096  c_action_data_ref(1);// R612
20097  c_action_procedure_designator();// R1219
20098  c_action_call_stmt(NULL, caf_spawn_subr, NULL, false);// R1218

20177  void c_action_next_token(Token_t* token)
20178  {
20179  // This parser action is used in a separate mode to read the tokens from
20180  // the file as part of a separate pass over the AST.
20181  ASSERT_not_null(token);
20182 
20183  string text = token->text;
20184  string currentFilename = getCurrentFilename();
20185  int line_number = token->line;
20186  int column_number = token->col;
20187 
20188  Sg_File_Info* starting_fileInfo = new Sg_File_Info(currentFilename,
20189  line_number, column_number);
20190 
20191  // Building the token as unclassified tokens (tokens can be classified by language, language construct, etc.)
20192  SgToken* roseToken = new SgToken(starting_fileInfo, text, 0);
20193 
20194  // Currently all SgLocatedNode objects are required to have a valid source code position for the start and end.
20195  // However this might be a bit redundant for the case of SgToken objects. So we might want to handle this
20196  // differently in the future.
20197  Sg_File_Info* ending_fileInfo = new Sg_File_Info(currentFilename,
20198  line_number, column_number + text.length());
20199  roseToken->set_endOfConstruct(ending_fileInfo);
20200 
20201  if (SgProject::get_verbose() > DEBUG_RULE_COMMENT_LEVEL)
20202  {
20203  printf(
20204  "In c_action_next_token = %s file = %s line = %d column = %d \n",
20205  SageInterface::get_name(roseToken).c_str(),
20206  currentFilename.c_str(), line_number, column_number);
20207  }
20208 
20209  // Verify that we have a propoer start and end source code position for the token.
20210  ROSE_ASSERT(roseToken->get_startOfConstruct() != NULL);
20211  ROSE_ASSERT(roseToken->get_endOfConstruct() != NULL);
20212 
20213  // Get the current file.
20214  SgSourceFile* currentFile = OpenFortranParser_globalFilePointer;
20215  ROSE_ASSERT(currentFile != NULL);
20216 
20217  // Add to the token list kept in the SgSourceFile object.
20218  currentFile->get_token_list().push_back(roseToken);
20219  }
